10304147.en: I see. Now that we have got it and honored my brother's last will, it would be improper to ask you to do me a favor again. Just plant it anywhere you want.
10304147.ch: 是，如今宝物已经取得，义兄在天之灵，于愿已足。原不该对恩人再有强求。请恩人随意选择种植之地便是。

10304148.en: I caused such a disturbance today, and I may get into trouble if I stay in Hua Feng too long. I'll leave now, and goodbye, my saver.
10304148.ch: 今日掀起偌大风波，只怕这华封州也不能久留了。我这便离开了。恩人，再见了。

10304149.en: {name|B} casts you a glance as he speaks. The frustration in his expression has disappeared. He inhales deeply and waves his hand to you, then he walks into the distance.
10304149.ch: {name|B}说着朝你看了一眼，原本失落的神态慢慢消失，他深深的吸了一口气，朝你挥了挥手，自向远处去了。

10304150.en: Thank you for granting my request! Let's set off there now!
10304150.ch: 多谢恩人成全，我们这便动身吧？

10304151.en: My saver, I'll tell you the truth. Such a thing must not be kept by me. And I could only destroy it if you declined me.
10304151.ch: 恩人，我坦白说吧。此物现在万万不能留在我手中。若你执意拒绝，我也只能毁掉九幻灵根了。

10304152.en: Maybe you don't know its trait yet. The Illusion Root has something similar to a spirit and will protect itself with powerful means. It usually hides underground and draws essence from the earth, and it will move around to evade other people's detections.
10304152.ch: 恩人有所不知，九幻灵根自具灵性，有极强的自保手段。一般情况下他潜藏地底，吸纳地气，四周游移。让旁人无法准确探知位置。

10304153.en: However, if the Root is still excavated, it will search for another source of essence. Then, the person who dug it out will be its prey and will die from being drawn out of all essence.
10304153.ch: 倘若九幻灵根仍是被起出，灵根脱离地气，便会另寻生机。起出九幻灵根的人就会被其吸纳敌人体内精元，直至衰竭枯死。

10304154.en: No need to worry about it. The Illusion Root is after all not as clever as a human being, and it will only regard the person excavated it as its enemy. In other words, only my essence will be drawn by the treasure.
10304154.ch: 恩人多虑了，九幻灵根虽有灵性，终究是物非人，因此它只认将它开挖出来的人为天敌。换言之，此宝只会吸纳我的真元。

10304155.en: If I keep it, the Root will continue to draw essence from me, and I will die from that. However, it's safe if I give it to someone else now. It can sustain itself since it has had the capacity after being nourished by my energy.
10304155.ch: 假若此物留在我手，则会一直吸纳我的真元，将我置诸死地。而它此时饱吸在下灵力已能自给自足，不假外求。灵根当下易手旁人，已无大碍。

10304156.en: Sigh. It is called the Illusion Root, but the name comes neither from its stub nor from the plain form like a wooden carving we saw before. Its true look is the crystalline and translucent appearance after drawing essence from human beings, and it earns the name because of that.
10304156.ch: 唉，所谓九幻灵根，不是指其幻根，亦非之前起出的木雕状的雏形，而是吸纳人体真元后呈现琉璃晶体外壳的真正形态。这才是九幻灵根的真身。

10304157.en: Here is a beautiful place with wonderful Feng Shui and plenty of Qi, so I buried my sworn brother here. Now you may plant the Illusion Root here, and it will begin to grow with the Qi around.
10304157.ch: 此地为风水幽胜之地，灵气充沛，因此昔年我将义兄埋骨于处。恩人如今可将九幻灵根种在此处，借周围灵气让灵根发芽生长。

10304158.en: You plant it into the soil again. To your surprise, root strands begin to grow around it and extend down to the earth in an instant.
10304158.ch: 你将灵根重新埋入地底之中，未料此物突然间增生各种触须，扎入土地之中。

10304159.en: Moments after, a verdant sprout emerges before you. It then grows into a sapling, and as its foliage thickens and its trunk expands, it develops into a tree. Now its size is as huge as a mansion, and it needs at least seven or eight persons' wingspan to encircle it.
10304159.ch: 不过须臾之间，一株碧绿的小苗拔地而出，继而逐渐长成小树，然后枝叶渐繁，树围渐粗，只眨眼间便成了七八人合围小楼似的大树。

10304160.en: Thank you very much, my saver! However, I'm afraid that I made a great disturbance this time, and I must leave here until the fuss dies down. It's time for me to leave.
10304160.ch: 多谢恩人成全。在下感激不尽！这次掀起风波，闹得实在太大了。还是早早藏匿起来避避风头为好。恩人，我也差不多该离开了

10304161.en: Things have finally been settled. Goodbye, my saver!
10304161.ch: 事情总算告一段落了，恩人，再见了！

10304162.en: {name|B} looks at the huge tree growing from the Illusion Root, and a smile finally appears on his worried face. He waves his hand to you and strides away into the distance.
10304162.ch: {name|B}看了看九幻灵根长成的大树，原本略有忧郁的脸上终于重新露出微笑。他朝你挥了挥手，然后大步流星朝远方去了。

10304163.en: Maybe I'll continue my journey of exploration and treasure hunting. I believe we'll meet again though the world is so vast. Will we be able to set off for another exploration together? Haha.
10304163.ch: 我应该会继续寻幽探秘，挖掘宝物。八荒虽大，相信你我仍有相见之时，那时恩人还会与我一并探宝吗？哈哈。

10304164.en: {name|B} looks at the huge tree growing from the Illusion Root, and a smile appears on his face. He murmurs, "Farewell, brother."
10304164.ch: {name|B}看着九幻灵根化生的大树，脸上露出微笑。他轻轻的说道：“大哥，再见了。”

10304166.en: {name|B} looks at the tree again, and a smile finally appears on his worrying face. He waves his hand to you and strides away into the distance.
10304166.ch: {name|B}又再看看九幻灵根长成的大树，原本略有忧郁的脸上终于重新露出微笑。他朝你挥了挥手，然后大步流星朝远方去了。

10304167.en: {name|B}'s expression turns sour as you finish.
10304167.ch: 你把话说完，{name|B}的表情瞬间变得十分奇怪。

10304168.en: W-What...? There is no such a thing...? The village head... lied to me?
10304168.ch: 什、什么……？根本没有九幻灵根……？村长……村长他骗了我吗？

10304170.en: My saver... please don't worry. I won't do bad things. I won't harm them... They are poor persons, and they must... tell me the lie out of good intentions...
10304170.ch: 恩人……恩人放心，我不会做傻事的。我不会对那个村子不利的……他们都是可怜人，他们不是、不是故意骗我的……

10304171.en: Stop... Give up... So all my efforts are in vain, right? Brother, my brother... I failed on my promise in the end...
10304171.ch: 罢手……罢手……到头来都只是一场空么？大哥……大哥……我始终没做到答应你的事……

10304172.en: {name|B} stands up tremblingly and staggers away. Soon, his figure disappears on the horizon...
10304172.ch: {name|B}颤颤巍巍的站了起来，踉跄着迈步行走，不多时便到了天地交际之处消失不见……

10304173.en: Plant the Root at the current location?
10304173.ch: 是否将手中灵根终于当前位置？

10304174.en: You plant it into the soil again. To your surprise, root strands begin to grow around its smooth, jade-like shell and extend down to the earth in an instant.
10304174.ch: 你将灵根重新埋入地底之中，未料此物四周光滑的玉璧不断增生各种触须，扎入土地之中。

10304176.en: A lush tree stands before you. Sunlight sheds through its verdant, emerald-like leaves and melts into glittering green spots on the ground. Its dense shade seems to be a canopy of some dreamland.
10304176.ch: 前方玉树参天，片片绿叶犹如碧玉，日光照耀下，在地面上折射出片片绿光，人在浓荫之下，彷如置身幻境之中。

10304177.en: You try to shake the tree's root. Its leaves rustle gently, and some translucent fruits plop down.
10304177.ch: 你摇动树根，沙沙声中，玉树摇曳摆动。忽听数声咚咚的闷响，地上已多了若干晶莹果实。

10304178.en: The tree has a lush, canopying foliage. Translucent strands hang down from its top, reflecting iridescent strips on the ground.
10304178.ch: 玉树枝繁叶茂，恍如伞盖，冠盖处垂下条条触须，恍如琉璃，在地上折射出各种颜色的幻影。

10304179.en: You try to shake the tree's root. The tree sways in the gentle breeze and reflects the sunlight into a motley of colorful spots through its foliage, turning the space under it into a dreamland of glimmering glasses.
10304179.ch: 你摇动树根，就着微风，玉树左摇右摆，婆娑树影中折射出各种色彩，地上恍如片片琉璃，晃动不已，人在其中，彷如置身幻境。

10304180.en: Two cultivators are under the tree. They are fighting each other with all their energy as if in a life-or-death duel.
10304180.ch: 两名修仙者在玉树下方，你来我去，各以灵力轰击对方，似乎要将之置诸死地。

10304181.en: Ridiculous! How could you find it if I didn't notice the colorful reflections?
10304181.ch: 岂有此理，若非得我发现这些五彩幻影，你如何找到这棵神奇的玉树？

10304182.en: Are you kidding me? The tree can transform and conceal itself, and without my artifact, how could you even get here?
10304182.ch: 笑话！玉树能幻千形，隐于幻境之中，若非我手中法宝，你如何能找到这个地方？

10304183.en: You want to hog the treasures!
10304183.ch: 我只知道你想独占此间好处！

10304184.en: Hmph. And you break your words! Draw your swords and see who'll win!
10304184.ch: 哼，撕破脸皮的可是你！不要废话，见个真章吧！

10304185.en: The two cultivators fight fiercely. Two painful cries come to you after some time, and they have already fallen on the ground.
10304185.ch: 两人互搏生死，只听二人各发一声惨叫，已倒在地上。

10304186.en: You walk to them for an inspection. They both intended to kill the opponent and keep the tree their own and now they're both dead.
10304186.ch: 你上前查看倒地二人，他们为了眼前玉树，互下死手，各负重创，眼看已是不活了。

10304201.en: Someone is waiting for you on the road with crossed arms. A glimmer shines through his eyes when he notices your approach. He steps to you.
10304201.ch: 大路上一人抱手等着，他察觉到你接近后，眼中精光一闪，随即朝你走来。

10304202.en: Hey, my saver, you're finally here!
10304202.ch: 恩人，这可总算等到你了。

10304203.en: Recently I delved into ten caves altogether and found this! I guess it may be of use to you, and I fetch it!
10304203.ch: 我近日连翻十个神秘洞天，总算给我找到这本好东西，我想着恩人可能需要，这就给您送来啦！

10304204.en: The next cave will open soon, and I'll go right now. No need to thank me, my saver! Hehe, goodbye!
10304204.ch: 下一个洞天打开的时间就在不久之后，我得赶紧走了。恩人，不用感谢我！真的不用！告辞，嘿嘿！

10304205.en: {name|B} giggles and waves you goodbye, then slips away immediately...
10304205.ch: {name|B}嘻嘻一笑，朝你一挥手，脚底抹油似的溜了……

10304206.en: Long time no see, my saver! Do you know what is it? Is it a good thing?
10304206.ch: 恩人！好久不见呐！你看这是什么？！是好东西吧？

10304207.en: Alright! Now it's yours! I'll give it to you!
10304207.ch: 好东西就对了！我现在要把这个东西送给您！

10304208.en: My saver, do you know how I got it? I hid for 49 days near a mythical beast and finally put it into my pocket after the monster fell asleep! Sounds thrilling, right?
10304208.ch: 恩人，我跟你说，这东西可是我在大妖兽身边蹲了七七四十九天，等到他熟睡这才从它手边偷来的，弥足珍贵吧？

10304209.en: Hehe. I cannot stay here too long since the monster's smell lingers on me after days of being at its side. Once it discovered its treasure has gone, it will certainly find me following the smell, and that would be bad! Goodbye!
10304209.ch: 嘿嘿，我留在妖兽身边多时，沾染了一身腥臊，因此不能多作停留，那狗妖兽发现东西不见了一定会循着蛛丝马迹找到我，到时可不妙得很！在下告辞了！

10304210.en: {name|B} glimpses around with a somewhat flustered expression. He giggles to you and runs away.
10304210.ch: {name|B}左右张望一下，透出仓惶的神色，他朝你嘿嘿一笑，随即就跑了。

10304211.en: Hey there, my saver! I've been waiting for you, and let's get right to the point. Here, take it!
10304211.ch: 恩人，终于等到你了？我知道你肯定有很多话说，咱们长话短说！这东西送给你！快收下！

10304212.en: That day I witnessed a treacherous disciple murdering the master, and I felt I must do something. Therefore, I stole his cherished trinket when he was meditating, hehe!
10304212.ch: 我跟你说，那天我看见一个忤逆弟子，杀死师尊。我心中不平，乘着他潜心打坐之际，偷了他的小宝贝。嘿嘿！

10304213.en: However, he has discovered that, and now he is chasing me all over the world! I will surely be able to defeat such a scum, but I am just unwilling to waste my time on him! Time to go, see you!
10304213.ch: 不过他已经发现我了，现在满天下追杀我！我倒不是打不过那个贱人，只是懒得跟他纠缠，我先走了啊！嘿嘿！

10304214.en: {name|B} stretches his neck to look into the far distance, and seeing no one is following him, he sighs in relief. Then, he grins and waves you goodbye, and hurries away.
10304214.ch: {name|B}引颈远眺，眼看无人跟随这才吁了口气，他朝你呲牙笑笑挥手，然后迈开脚步急急的离开了。

10304215.en: Good day, my saver! You are the best person I've ever met! Haha!
10304215.ch: 恩人好，恩人妙，恩人好得呱呱叫！嘿嘿！

10304216.en: Well, bond with me? Eh... I prefer not to do so. Yes, please not...
10304216.ch: 啊！结、结义？咳！咳！这个暂且不了吧？对，不要，不能的……

10304217.en: Oh? I didn't expect that you thought about it, but I guess I would be your burden, so I must decline you.
10304217.ch: 我咋不知道你对我还有这样的意思呐？不过我可不敢高攀你呀！对不起呀！

10304218.en: Well, I can't do that. I would be feeling guilty if I mislead you.
10304218.ch: 不能的，不能的，我怕我会教坏你呢！

10304219.en: Well, I prefer not to do so, for fear that you would kill me because I'm too annoying.
10304219.ch: 不能的，不能的！我怕会惹怒了你，被你一怒之下就将我杀了，哈哈！

10304221.en: Oh, a gift from my saver! Thank you very much!
10304221.ch: 哎呦，这是恩人送我的礼物呐！却之不恭！却之不恭！

10304222.en: Alright, I'll have a spar with you if you like. Come on!
10304222.ch: 恩人技痒，在下只好奉陪了！来吧！

10304223.en: Well, no! The secret technique I followed can be performed by only one person at the same time, and dual cultivation will result in your death. That's unacceptable!
10304223.ch: 不能的，不能的！这怎么可以！恩人，我修炼的可是独门秘法，一旦合修，势必叫对方爆体而亡，这是绝对不能的！

10304224.en: Alright, let's begin! I am a good debater!
10304224.ch: 来来来！放马过来，我最喜欢动嘴皮子了！

10304225.en: Well, no. I guess you're planning a stab in my back, hehe.
10304225.ch: 我不去，我知道的，恩人你想敲我闷棍对不对？哈哈。

10304226.en: Oh, are you trying to include me in your plan? But now I'm busy with my own plans, so I can't go with you.
10304226.ch: 哎呦，恩人这是拉我入伙吗？不过我现在还有大事未了，不能

10304227.en: Whoa, you're so skillful! I couldn't even discern such a nimble technique!
10304227.ch: 恩人，你咋这么厉害？你用的手法我竟没看出来！

10304228.en: You chose it, and it would be your decision. We're strangers from now on!
10304228.ch: 恩人，这是你选的，今后你我就再无瓜葛了啊！

10304229.en: Will you trust me, my saver? I'm forced into it.
10304229.ch: 恩人，你会信任我吗？这一切都是不得已的。

10304230.en: Sorry, an important matter is waiting for me, and I won't bond with you before getting it done.
10304230.ch: 还有一件大事必须完成，在那之前我不能和你结义，抱歉了。

10304231.en: No, I prefer not to do so. Maybe there is a misunderstanding between us?
10304231.ch: 不能的，不能的。话说，恩人对我是不是有什么误会？

10304232.en: No, I have nothing to teach you.
10304232.ch: 不能的，我可没什么可以教给你呢。

10304233.en: No, you will be annoyed badly by such a disciple.
10304233.ch: 不能的，我做你的徒儿，你会被气死的。

10304234.en: Take it if you like, my saver.

10304235.en: Thank you very much! I'll keep your gift carefully.
10304235.ch: 多谢恩人馈赠，我会珍惜此物的。

10304236.en: I am occupied by urgent matters and must decline you this time. Maybe we could have a spar some other day.
10304236.ch: 不能的，恩人，眼下我还有要事，暂时不切磋了，可好？

10304237.en: Sorry, I must decline you since I can't be distracted now.
10304237.ch: 不能的，恩人，我暂时有事不能分心。抱歉了。

10304238.en: Maybe not. I'm feeling very disturbed these days, please forgive me.
10304238.ch: 不能的，近日我心中十分不安宁，恩人请赎罪。

10304239.en: No, I'm not in the mood for it now.
10304239.ch: 不能的，在下现在没心情呢。

10304240.en: Thank you, but I must decline your invitation since I'm too inexperienced to work with you.
10304240.ch: 不能的，现在的我还不适合与恩人共事呢。

10304241.en: You're an expert in this trade, right? You nearly escaped my eyes.
10304241.ch: 恩人空空妙手挺精妙的，我差点就察觉不出来呢。

10304242.en: This is the last time I call you as my saver. We will be strangers from now on.
10304242.ch: 恩人，此战无论输赢，你我之间，恩断义绝。

10304243.en: Hey, my saver! The sky is so bright today!
10304243.ch: 哎呀，恩人，今儿天空明媚得很呐！

10304244.en: I'm glad to hear that! Now that you are willing to bond with me, we will be sworn brothers!
10304244.ch: 好极好极，恩人既有此意，咱们义结金兰，从此你我便是异姓亲人！

10304245.en: Okay! Well, I'm feeling somewhat shy in hearing that!
10304245.ch: 能的，能的。哎呀，恩人，你这样让我有点害羞啊！

10304246.en: Eh? I'm afraid that such a bad master like me will mislead you.
10304246.ch: 不能吧？你要拜我为师？不怕我教坏了你吗？

10304247.en: Well, no. Let's be friends as usual.
10304247.ch: 不能吧？咱们平常做朋友就得了。

10304248.en: Take it if this is useful to you, my saver.
10304248.ch: 恩人，要的尽管拿去就是了。

10304249.en: Thank you! You saved me from danger before, and now you give me a gift!
10304249.ch: 谢谢，恩人不但对在下恩重如山，还送我这玩意呢！

10304250.en: Let's have a spar if you are in such a high mood! Come on, fight with all your might!
10304250.ch: 恩人有这兴致，在下又怎能拒绝？出招吧，全力以赴哦！

10304251.en: Sounds good! My saver, I guess my knowledge would benefit you a lot in such a cultivation!
10304251.ch: 来来来！恩人，我将所有心得都告诉你，咱们赶紧双修！

10304252.en: Debate? Alright! Pick a topic and let's begin!
10304252.ch: 恩人说要论道，咱们就来论道！出题目吧！

10304253.en: Ah, certainly! Sightseeing in such a beautiful world is always delightful to me.
10304253.ch: 哎呦，能的能的！在下最喜欢的就是观山看水，流连于大自然之中。

10304254.en: Okay! Now that you need me, I'll follow your instructions as you want!
10304254.ch: 是、是！恩人有命，水里水里去，火里火里去！你说去哪就去哪！

10304255.en: Eh? You must be an expert in this trade, but maybe your skill is out of practice.
10304255.ch: 哎？恩人呐，我觉得你这一手空空妙手，还有进步空间。

10304256.en: My saver, the thought of fighting against you saddens me a lot!
10304256.ch: 恩人，你永远不知道，要与你动手，我是有多痛心！

10304425.en: Senior brother, I found the cultivator in this place before!
10304425.ch: 师兄，我之前便在这儿发现那名修士的！

10304426.en: I see. Our target won't be too far from here. Follow my instructions and keep an eye on that person. Reply to me once you find something odd.
10304426.ch: 知道了。此人就在这附近活动，你依我嘱咐，继续留神此人行踪，一旦发现，速速报我。

10304428.en: Hmph, what a sly fox. I'll find you someday; just evade from me if you can.
10304428.ch: 哼，真是个机灵鬼。尽管躲避吧，我绝对会找到你的！

10304429.en: The cultivator grits his teeth and rides on a flying sword with the other person. They disappear into the distant sky in seconds.
10304429.ch: 前方修仙者咬咬牙，然后一拂袖召来飞剑与身边之人离去，只眨眼间远空之中，已无二人踪影。

10304430.en: {name|B} is about to say something, but he decides to remain silent after a brief pause.
10304430.ch: {name|B}想说什么，然而只一沉吟，便将已在嘴边的话重新吞到肚子里头。

10304431.en: A person before you is inspecting the terrains around him, stroking his chin with his hand. He stamps the ground occasionally and looks distressed, but after seeing you, a bright smile emerges on his face.
10304431.ch: 前方一人摸着下巴观察四周山水形势，不时用脚踩踏地面，透出苦恼的表情。然而他看见你来到后禁不住露出喜色。

10304432.en: Hey, my saver! Do you know what's hiding before us? It's all good stuff! Let's have an exploration into it now, okay?
10304432.ch: 是恩人呐！你知道前面有什么吗？里面有好东西啊！不如咱们进去探索探索！好不好？

10304433.en: You entered the mystic realm with {name|B}, but monsters thronged out suddenly and surrounded you two.
10304433.ch: 你与{name|B}一同进入秘境之中，没料周围突然出现大量妖兽围住你两。

10304435.en: Because my guess is true! Haha, but let's talk about that after defeating them!
10304435.ch: 我这不是猜中了吗？哈哈！哎呦，咱们先收拾了这些杂碎再说别的！

10304436.en: From risks comes wealth, and these petty beasts are certainly not our opponents. Let's deal with them first!
10304436.ch: 泼天的富贵需到风险之中去相求，这小小妖物算得了什么，咱们先打！

10304437.en: I flee... What do you mean, my dear saver? I'll stand at your side forever and will never flee, never! ...Oh, no! Too many minor monsters!
10304437.ch: 恩人，我先走……哎？说什么傻话，我与恩人生死与共，绝不会先行逃走的！啊啊啊啊，好多小妖！

10304438.en: Yes, you are always victorious and invincible and will certainly defeat them in one go, so I'll go... Well, I'm just kidding. Our friendship stands all tests, and I won't leave you here! Charge!
10304438.ch: 是，恩人旗开得胜节节胜利瓜熟蒂落顺其自然，那么我先去……不是，咱们是过命的交情，我怎能抛下你？杀啊！

10304439.en: After a fierce battle, {name|B} rummaged through the place and handed you several precious items.
10304439.ch: 激斗之后，{name|B}将这地方搜了个遍，然后摸出几样宝贵的物品递到你手。

10304440.en: Ehehe, my saver. You deserve them. Look, they are all good stuff, right?
10304440.ch: 嘿嘿，恩人，这是你应得的，怎么样，东西都不错吧？

10304441.en: {name|B} waves goodbye to you and leaves with a giggle after giving you his gift.
10304441.ch: {name|B}将东西交给你后，便与你扬手作别，嘻嘻哈哈的走了。

10304443.en: I swear I don't know! After all, it's just a guess, and I only want to take the treasure here.
10304443.ch: 我发誓！我真不知道！我只是看中此地的宝物而已呀！

10304444.en: My dear saver, you will certainly eliminate these petty monsters in one fell swoop! Let's fight together and defeat them!
10304444.ch: 恩人，这些小怪还能难倒你吗？咱们并肩子上！灭了他们！

10304445.en: Okay! Well, I won't let you face them alone, never!
10304445.ch: 好！不，我怎能让恩人独自面对危险，绝对不可以！

10304446.en: The fierce battle ended soon, {name|B} also rummaged through the place and handed you several precious items.
10304446.ch: 激斗很快结束，{name|B}亦将此地方搜了个遍，然后摸出几样宝贵的物品递到你手。

10304447.en: I recalled our past. Remember? We ventured into so many dangerous places not long after we met each other.
10304447.ch: 真让人怀念啊，当初与恩人结识之际，也是经常一起闯荡危险的地方呢。

10304448.en: {name|B} seems to be lost in some delightful memories. He stays with you for some more time before waving you goodbye and leaving.
10304448.ch: {name|B}看起来像是想起从前的事情了，他与你一起待了片刻，这才挥了挥手作别，自往远处去了。

10304449.en: Why would there be monsters? I checked the place and found no monsters before!
10304449.ch: 怎么会这样子的呢？明明看过这边没有妖物！

10304450.en: Yes, they're here for no reason... Alright, it's my fault, but let's defeat them together before blaming me!
10304450.ch: 对啊！可现在明明就有妖兽！怪我怪我！咱们先灭了这些妖物再说！

10304451.en: My fault! I'll take care in the future... Well, they're charging to us! Fight!
10304451.ch: 失误！失误！我以后会注意点的了！哎呦，来了来了！咱们上！

10304452.en: Thank you very much, my reliable saver! However, I won't step away and see you fighting alone, let's stand together against dangers!
10304452.ch: 哎呦，有恩人这样的大靠山真好！但我是绝对不会让恩人独自应战的，咱们有难同当！

10304453.en: You eliminated the monsters in one go, and after ascertaining all of them are dead, {name|B} steps to you and presents the treasure he found.
10304453.ch: 你一举荡平群妖，{name|B}则确定过这些妖兽一一死绝，这才来到你跟前将所得交到你手。

10304454.en: Luckily, we get good stuff from those monsters, and they get what they deserve for wreaking havoc in the surrounding villages. Hehe!
10304454.ch: 东西不错，还不算吃亏！叫你们肆虐周边村镇！嘿嘿！

10304455.en: Ehehe, my saver! I located and eliminated the monsters that were rampaging in the land, and you also did a favor to the people here!
10304455.ch: 嘿嘿，恩人，我坦白！这些妖物影响了州中安宁，因此我来扫荡一番，将他们剿灭了！恩人为州中做了件好事呢！

10304456.en: Just as {name|B} finishes speaking, a jubilant crowd of mortals finds you. They express much gratitude to you for helping the land get rid of the monsters.
10304456.ch: {name|B}话才说完，喧哗声至。不少凡人来到，对你感恩戴德，顶礼膜拜，说是多谢仙长斩妖除魔。

10304457.en: You wonder what on earth is {name|B} planning, but he just waves goodbye to you with a giggle and walks quietly into the distance.
10304457.ch: 你正想知道{name|B}到底在搞什么鬼，而他已嘿嘿一笑朝你一挥手，默默往远方去了。

10304470.en: You see {name|B} sitting in the corner of the tavern. He is drinking from his cup, but he occasionally glimpses around with sharp eyes. He smiles as he notices you.
10304470.ch: 酒馆之中，却见{name|B}正坐在角落之中举杯饮酒，不时眼中透出精芒四处扫视。他看见你来到，立即露出笑嘻嘻的表情。

10304471.en: Greetings, my saver! I didn't expect to see you in the tavern, and what about coming here and drinking with me? Haha!
10304471.ch: 呀，原来恩人也会来酒馆啊！咱们喝一杯！哈哈！

10304472.en: You have a drink with {name|B}, and soon the liquor jar is empty. You feel yourself glow with a comfortable warmth.
10304472.ch: 你与{name|B}共饮，不多时酒浆告尽，你只觉全身暖洋洋的受用不尽。

10304473.en: Ah, it's wonderful to have a drink with my saver!
10304473.ch: 哎呀，能和恩人共谋一醉真好啊！

10304474.en: An idea seems to come into {name|B}'s mind. He hastily bids you goodbye with much apologies and hurries away.
10304474.ch: {name|B}说着，似乎想起来了什么，立即赔笑着起身告辞，匆匆忙忙自往别处去了。

10304475.en: Hey, my saver! Have a drink with me!
10304475.ch: 是恩人！恩人来！咱们一起喝酒！

10304476.en: You share a drink with {name|B}, and soon the liquor jar is empty. A warm, comforting feeling washes over you.
10304476.ch: 你与{name|B}共饮，不多时酒浆告尽，你只觉全身暖洋洋的受用不尽。

10304477.en: I encountered my saver in the tavern, that's incredible! It seems that I should patronize here more often, hehe.
10304477.ch: 啧啧，原来在酒馆也能遇见恩人，看来我以后得多多光顾了！嘿嘿。

10304478.en: {name|B} chats with you happily on various topics, and soon the liquor jar is empty. He bids you goodbye and leaves; maybe he is setting off for another mystic realm now?
10304478.ch: {name|B}乘着酒兴跟你天南地北的聊着，不多时饮尽酒浆，便跟你道别离去。也许这家伙又匆忙赶去下一个秘境之中寻找宝物了吧？

10304479.en: Greetings, my saver! What about having a drink together? I didn't expect that you also like to... well, patronize the tavern. What a coincidence!
10304479.ch: 恩人，来来来，咱们喝一杯！没想到恩人也有喝酒这种不良……良好习惯！真是投在下所好！嘿嘿！

10304480.en: {name|B} leads you into the tavern with giggles and drinks with you. Shortly after, you feel yourself glow with a comfortable warmth.
10304480.ch: {name|B}嘻嘻哈哈将你迎到酒馆之中，与你共饮。不多时你只觉全身暖洋洋的受用不尽。

10304481.en: It would be wonderful if we could drink together all the day!
10304481.ch: 如果以后天天都能跟恩人饮酒，那该有多好啊！

10304482.en: {name|B} looks out of the window. The shadow of the pole nearby indicates the time has passed noon. He seems to be remembering something and immediately stands up. He bids you goodbye and leaves hurriedly.
10304482.ch: {name|B}抬眼看向窗外，日光下，不远处杆影偏斜，已是过午。他似乎记起了什么事情，立即起身笑嘻嘻的跟你道别，匆匆忙忙的往别处去了。

10304483.en: You walk into the tavern just as {name|B} rushes here. He looks around and comes to you as he notices you.
10304483.ch: 你来到酒肆之中，恰逢此时{name|B}急急忙忙的也跑了进来，他四处张望，看见你后便笑嘻嘻的来到你身边。

10304484.en: Greetings, my saver! I'll lead you to a place now, please follow me. We may drink together later!
10304484.ch: 恩人，今日不忙喝酒，咱们去个地方！请跟我来！嘿嘿！

10304485.en: Here you are. Look at there!
10304485.ch: 恩人来了啊！嘿嘿，看好了！

10304486.en: You see the ground in front is wet with an unknown liquid and covered by wood shards and branches. A mixed scent flows into your nose, from which you discern the fragrance of pine wood as well as a strong liquor aroma. {name|B} walks near it and snaps his finger, and with the sparks falling to the ground, a bluish flame rises before you.
10304486.ch: 前方土地上被不知名液体濡湿大片，上面杂陈碎木树枝。鼻子轻嗅，除去松木香气，还有浓烈酒香。{name|B}上前打个响指，飞出几点火星，地上顿时冒起大片蓝光。

10304487.en: The ignited wood shards crackle and jump into the sky in a series of exploding sounds, turning into colorful, spectacular fireworks above your head.
10304487.ch: 那上面的碎木一经点燃，立即哔啵作响相继炸裂飞上半空，化为朵朵五颜六色的烟花。

10304488.en: Ahaha. Is it marvelous, my saver?

10304489.en: Hehe. I noticed an evil cultivator trying to brew a spiritual liquor with the essence of living beings, so I stayed in taverns for days to find his whereabouts and decided to teach him a lesson.
10304489.ch: 嘿嘿，最近我发现了一名邪修损害生灵，私酿灵酒。因此我流连酒肆数日，查到那恶徒的行踪，打算好好惩治他一番。

10304490.en: However, he would be too formidable if I really fought him, so I could only steal the three jars of liquor out there. He cherishes the brew a lot, and by doing that, I also make him unable to create such a drinking again.
10304490.ch: 只可惜，动手我是打不过此人，只好将他视为珍宝的三坛仙酿尽数偷了，断了他继续酿制此物的念想。

10304491.en: The liquor will benefit your body if drinking in sips, but it will also harm you if you booze. Therefore, I smashed the other two jars and ignited the liquor for a marvelous fireworks show, and I present the remaining one to you!
10304491.ch: 这玩意适量进饮于道体有益，但一旦多喝便会形成损伤。因此我将其余两坛砸碎倒在地上点了烟花看。剩下一坛则转送恩人您！

10304492.en: Haha. This is the only remaining jar of the brew. A precious drink, right? However, the evildoer is chasing me right now, and I must go. See you, my saver!
10304492.ch: 哈哈，此酒天下只此一坛，弥足珍贵吧？嘿嘿，不过那个狗东西正在追踪我呢，我得赶紧走了！恩人，改天见，哈哈！

10304493.en: {name|B} presents the jar to you and waves goodbye, then he leaves in a hurry.
10304493.ch: {name|B}将酒交到你手，朝你挥手道别，匆匆忙忙的走了。

10304494.en: This is a mellow liquor for living up this show, please take it, my saver!
10304494.ch: 这是助兴的美酒，恩人请收下，嘿嘿！

10304495.en: {name|B} hands the jar to you the next moment and waves goodbye with a giggle, and then he leaves in a hurry.
10304495.ch: {name|B}急忙将酒交到你手中，嘻嘻哈哈的朝你挥手道别，然后匆匆忙忙的走了。

10304496.en: Oh, you don't like fireworks show? Never mind! I guess you'll like mellow liquors, so please take it!
10304496.ch: 哈哈！恩人不喜欢烟火没关系，这个却是好东西！是一坛美酒，送给您！

10304498.en: You drink the liquor in the jar and feel its strengthening warmth filling you. You look into the jar and find there is not much liquor remaining.
10304498.ch: 你饮下坛中琼浆，酒力化为暖意，涌向全身，让你充满力量。回看坛中，酒浆余量已然不多了。

10304499.en: You drink the liquor in the jar and feel its strengthening warmth filling you.
10304499.ch: 你饮尽坛中美酒，酒力转化为暖意，涌向全身，让你充满力量。

10304500.en: Such a liquor may boost as well as harm people. Consuming it excessively will result in getting poisoned.
10304500.ch: 此酒虽有大用，亦有大害，饮用太过，将会引发剧毒。

10305001.en: Fellow cultivator, care to play a game? If you win, this {1} is yours. Lose, and your {2} is mine.
10305001.ch: 道友，有没有兴趣玩个游戏，赢了这{1}就是你的，若是输了，你的{2}就是我的了。

10305003.en: Tough luck, fellow cultivator. I won.
10305003.ch: 道友运气不佳，这局是我赢了。

10305004.en: Lucky break, fellow cultivator. You won.
10305004.ch: 道友运气不错，这局是你赢了。

10305005.en: A worthy opponent, indeed. What an honor.

10305006.en: Hold on a moment. I need to fetch something.
10305006.ch: 等我片刻，我去取个东西。

10305007.en: My luck was poor earlier. This is my prized {3}. Let's play again. If you win, this {3} is yours. Lose, and you return the {1}.
10305007.ch: 刚才是我运气不好，这是我珍藏的{3}，我们再玩一次，赢了这{3}就是你的，若是输了，你可要把{1}还给我。

10305008.en: I appreciate you being upfront with me. Let's play.

10305009.en: You coward! Fleeing after your win?

10305024.en: Draw a point from 1 to 6. Highest score wins, but go over 10 and you lose. Your total: {2}, Opponent's total: {1}.
10305024.ch: 每次抽签从1到6点中随机获得点数，总点数大于对方获胜，但是点数超过10点判负。你的点数：{2}，对方点数：{1}。

10305025.en: You drew {3} points. Your total: {2}, Opponent's total: {1}.
10305025.ch: 你抽中了{3}点，你的点数：{2}，对方点数：{1}。

10305032.en: {0} drew {3} points. Your total: {2}, Opponent's total: {1}.
10305032.ch: {0}抽中了{3}点，你的点数：{2}，对方点数：{1}。

10305039.en: Now it's back where it belongs. Excellent.

10305040.en: Oh, shoot! Luck's not on my side today. We'll settle this another time.
10305040.ch: 气煞我也。今日手气不佳，改日再一决高下。

10305041.en: {0} ends the draw. Your total: {2}, Opponent's total: {1}.
10305041.ch: {0}结束抽签。你的点数：{2}，对方点数：{1}。

10305042.en: You owe me that {0} from our last faceoff. Hand it over!
10305042.ch: 上次博弈，我珍藏的{0}输给了你，交出来吧！

10306000.en: You spot a strange sword on the ground, radiating a sinister energy.
10306000.ch: 击杀对方后，地上一柄古剑引起了你的注意，此剑邪气缭绕，诡异莫名。

10306001.en: This sword is no ordinary weapon. It's a cursed blade radiating a sinister energy, hungry for souls.
10306001.ch: 剑上诡异危险的气息吸引着你，等回过神来的时候才发现，不知何时剑已被你牢牢抓在手中…

10306002.ch: 一种仿佛不是来自于这个世界的凄厉声音从剑上传来，剑也随之失去灵性慢慢消散…

10306003.ch: 一股狂暴邪恶的力量从剑中冲出，吞噬了对方的元魂。

10306004.en: A faint, cold gleam catches your eye. Looking up, you discover an ancient sword floating silently in the air, emanating an ethereal, chilling radiance. The air around the blade seems to warp and twist, exuding an aura of death. An inexplicable, compelling force emanates from the sword, drawing you closer.
10306004.ch: 你的视线被一抹微弱的寒光吸引，抬头望去，发现一把古剑静静地悬浮在空中，散发着幽冷的光辉。剑身周围，空气似乎都在轻微扭曲，散发出一股死亡的气息，一股无法言喻的吸引力仿佛从剑上传来。

10306005.ch: <r>噬魂剑传来阵阵呓语…“元魂…元魂…”。</r>

10306006.en: Discovered a sword radiating a sinister energy.
10306006.ch: “元魂…给我元魂！”噬魂剑越来越狂暴脱离了你的控制！一股邪恶的气息从噬魂剑上传来！

10306007.ch: 一场大战之后，你击退了狂暴的噬魂剑。

10306008.ch: 当噬魂剑发现没有能力吞噬你的元魂后，瞬间飞走。

10306009.en: Suddenly, someone blocks your path. A voice rings out: "{name|A}, you wicked fiend! Your crimes are unforgivable! Murdering innocents and devouring their souls to feed a demonic blade—you've defied the laws of heaven itself! We of the righteous path shall make you pay for your sins! Today shall be your last!"
10306009.ch: 突然有人拦住了你的去路，同时一道声音传来：“{name|A}，你这个邪恶之徒，真是罪不可赦！杀人噬魂，吞噬无辜的灵魂来祭炼魔剑，违逆天理，丧尽天良！我等正道之人定要让你为自己的罪行付出代价！今日就是你的死期！”

10306010.en: As you pass through an area, you notice the vegetation has withered and died, the earth cracked and split. Animal carcasses lie scattered on the ground, and the air is heavy with the stench of death. Following this sinister aura, you find an ancient sword that catches your eye; dark energy swirls around it in an inexplicably bizarre manner.
10306010.ch: 路过一片区域时，你发现周围草木枯死，土地龟裂，偶尔能见到几只动物的遗骸躺在地上，空气中弥漫着一股死亡的气息。循着这股气息来到区域中心，一柄古剑引起了你的注意，此剑邪气缭绕，诡异莫名。

10306011.en: After witnessing you devour souls, {name|B} becomes deeply troubled and can no longer face what you've become. The person ultimately decides to sever all ties with you!
10306011.ch: 无意中看到你吞噬元魂后{name|B}郁郁寡欢，感觉无法再面对这样的你，并最终决定断绝关系！

10306101.en: Somehow, you notice the Soul Reaver has materialized beside you when it should have been in your Interspatial Ring. Moreover, your connection with the sword has been severed without you realizing when...
10306101.ch: 不知何时，你发现本应该收在储物戒中的噬魂剑出现在旁边，而你与剑的感应也不知何时断绝…

10306102.en: A voice echoes within your soul: "Despite the hardships and setbacks, most of my power has been restored."
10306102.ch: 你的灵魂中传来一个声音：“尽管经历曲折艰难，但我的修为已经恢复大半了。”

10306103.en: Your kindness to me is truly beyond repayment. How about this...
10306103.ch: “您对我的恩德真是无以为报，不如这样吧……”

10306104.en: "Since you've helped me this far, why not lend me your soul to complete my recovery? Haha..."
10306104.ch: “帮人帮到底，将你的元魂借给我，助我恢复修为如何？桀桀桀……”

10306105.en: An indescribable, piercing shriek emanates from the Soul Reaver... When the sound finally fades, your mystic connection with the sword returns!
10306105.ch: 噬魂剑上传来无法描述的凄厉声音…待声音完全消失后你与剑的感应又回来了！

10306106.en: <r>All powers from the Soul Reaver will be unavailable during this battle.</r>
10306106.ch: <r>此战将无法使用所有来自于噬魂剑的力量</r>

10306107.en: While passing {#fortuitous_event_name60012}, the Soul Reaver suddenly trembles, transmitting a sensation of restless energy.
10306107.ch: 路过{#fortuitous_event_name60012}时，噬魂剑突然震动了一下，一种躁动感从噬魂剑上传递了过来。

10306108.en: A thought flashes through your mind—could there be something here that's drawing the Soul Reaver's attention?
10306108.ch: 你心念一动，难道这里有什么东西在吸引着噬魂剑？

10306109.en: As you look at the {itemLink8104141} just obtained from {#fortuitous_event_name60012}, the Soul Reaver grows even more frenzied as if craving this {itemLink8104141}!
10306109.ch: 看着刚刚从{#fortuitous_event_name60012}中获得的{itemLink8104141}，噬魂剑更加狂躁了，似乎它在渴望着这块{itemLink8104141}！

10306110.en: You decide to save it for the right moment.
10306110.ch: 你决定留待合适的时机使用它。

10306111.en: The soul energy within the {itemLink8104141} slowly merges with the Soul Reaver...
10306111.ch: {itemLink8104141}中的魂力慢慢融入噬魂剑中…

10306201.en: Upon seeing you, the person immediately turns and flees.
10306201.ch: 看到你后，对方转身就跑。

10306221.en: I sensed a sinister aura earlier... it seemed to be coming from you? {call|B|A}... are you alright...
10306221.ch: 我之前感应到一股阴邪的气息，似乎是从你身上传来的？{call|B|A}…你没事吧…

10306223.en: {call|B|A}... your current state is rather frightening. I won't tell anyone about what happened today, but the aura emanating from this sword is malevolent and far from benign. This can't be the path you wish to follow.
10306223.ch: {call|B|A}…你现在的样子有点吓人，今天的事情我不会跟人说的，但这剑散发的气息很邪性绝非善类，我相信这不是你追求的“道”。

10306241.en: I sensed a sinister aura earlier... it was coming from you? {call|B|A}... what's going on...
10306241.ch: 我之前感应到一股阴邪的气息，是从你身上传来的？{call|B|A}…这是怎么回事…

10306243.en: I won't force you to speak if you don't wish to, but as cultivators, we must know where to draw our moral lines.
10306243.ch: 你要是不愿意说我也不会勉强，但我等修道之人亦有可为与不可为。

10306261.en: Demon! Since fate has led me to you, I shall purge this evil for the good of all!
10306261.ch: 邪祟！既然让我碰到了理当为民除害！

10306262.en: Wait! Other people are detected within <r>{0}</r> tiles. Devouring souls now will surely be discovered and draw Righteous cultivators to hunt us down. Do you still wish to devour the soul?
10306262.ch: 等等，这是我第一次在吞噬元魂时感应到附近<r>{0}格</r>内有其它人，这时候吞噬元魂必定会被人发现引来正道修士的截杀，<r>极其危险</r>。真的要吞噬元魂吗？

10307001.en: {name|A}! You?! I never thought this remnant of my soul would meet another familiar face.
10307001.ch: 道友请留步…我已经快感应不到任何东西了…庆幸还能遇到道友…还请你帮我一个忙…

10307002.en: I still have unfinished business in this world. Would you help me one last time?
10307002.ch: 我灵魂即将消散…尚有心愿未了…我只记得{2}是对我很重要的人…这{0}是我身前最重要的东西…你可愿帮我带给{2}？ 这{1}愿送与你作为报答…

10307005.en: Thank you... You can learn more about {0} at the town tavern.
10307005.ch: 谢谢你…… 在城镇酒馆也许可以打听到{0}的消息…

10307006.ch: 唉…道友不便相助…也是我命该如此…

10307007.en: As I depart from this world, I leave you this {0}, my most cherished possession. May it serve you well.
10307007.ch: 我灵魂即将消散…这{0}是我身前最重要的东西…就送与你吧…希望能帮到你…

10307008.en: Sadly, I won't live to see {call|B|A} reach enlightenment... Farewell.
10307008.ch: 我却看不到{call|B|A}得道的那一天了…可惜……再见了。

10307009.en: Thank you for keeping your promise. We part ways here. Perhaps in another life, we'll meet again on the path of the way.
10307009.ch: 谢谢你遵守承诺…帮我完成心愿…就此别过…若有来世…再为道友…

10307021.en: Under the influence of {yinyangEyeSoul|3006}, {0} desires a dual cultivation with me.
10307021.ch: {name|A}！没想到竟是你这无耻之徒！我都死了你还不肯放过我，今日我定要将你碎尸万段！

10307031.en: {0} shared some thoughts on {1} with me. I found {0}'s perspective insightful, improving my relationship with {1}.
10307031.ch: 道友请留步…我已经快感应不到任何东西了…庆幸还能遇到道友…还请你帮我一个忙…

10307032.en: Fate has brought us together. Here, a little gift for you! (Obtained {yinyangEyeSoul|3011})
10307032.ch: 我灵魂即将消散…尚有心愿未了…我只记得{2}是对我很重要的人…这{0}是我身前最重要的东西…你可愿帮我带给{2}？ 这{1}愿送与你作为报答…

10307033.en: {yinyangEyeSoul|3011} helped me write a heartfelt letter to {1}, deepening our bond.
10307033.ch: 我灵魂即将消散…不知道友可否帮我找{0}报仇…这{1}愿送与你作为报答…

10307034.en: {0} sent me a sincere letter, expressing {0}'s feelings. Our relationship has grown warmer.

10307035.en: Fate has brought us together. Here, a little gift for you! (Obtained {yinyangEyeSoul|3012})
10307035.ch: 我想起来了，有人看到{0}在{1}附近出现过，你去那里找找吧。

10307036.en: I sparred with {0}, and {yinyangEyeSoul|3012} granted me a deeper understanding of {0}.

10307037.en: Fate has brought us together. Here, a little gift for you! (Obtained {yinyangEyeSoul|3013})
10307037.ch: 我已油尽灯枯…就此别过…

10307111.en: No, please don't kill me! Take everything, please!
10307111.ch: 别，别杀我，这些东西都给你。

10307121.en: As you approach, the spirit vanishes. Just as you begin to wonder why, a dragon's roar echoes within your heart, and a primordial power begins to spread.
10307121.ch: 你刚刚靠近，灵体就消失不见了，你正觉奇怪时一声龙吟在你心中回响，一股荒古的力量蔓延开来。

10307122.en: I could help you comprehend the Move Mind Skills, but it seems you no longer need my guidance.
10307122.ch: 我能助你参悟劲心法，但你似乎已经不需要我的力量了。

10307131.en: O Immortal, I can enhance your Charisma, granting you divine appearance in the eyes of cultivators. They will seek you out for Dual Cultivation, advancing your powers!
10307131.ch: 仙长，我能帮你提升魅力，让你成为异性修士眼中的仙姿，让他们一个个找你双修，增进修为！

10307141.en: Would you like my help? When the opportunity arises, I can not only prevent others from stealing your belongings but also... help myself to their valuable treasures for you.
10307141.ch: 要不要我帮帮忙？只要有机会，我不但可以阻止旁人偷你的东西，还能顺手从对方身上摸一个贵重宝物过来。

10307151.en: The art of shifting blame is delicate work. Once I act, your assault against cultivators will be pinned on nearby scapegoats!
10307151.ch: 移花接木是门技术活，我一旦出手，你击败修士的事情，自会由附近的替罪羊承担！

10307161.en: O Immortal, knowing how busy you are with cultivation, I can help prevent misunderstandings between you and your partner. Simply tell me what you want to say, and I shall deliver it on your behalf.
10307161.ch: 仙长修炼繁忙，为避免仙侣之间误会导致不和，只需告诉我想要传达给仙侣的消息，我能迅速为仙长代劳传达。

10307171.en: O Immortal, knowing how busy you are with cultivation, I can help prevent your partner from feeling neglected. Simply tell me what you want to say, and I shall deliver it on your behalf.
10307171.ch: 仙长修炼繁忙，为避免怠慢仙侣遭致误解，只需告诉我想要传达给仙侣的消息，我能迅速为仙长代劳传达。

10307181.en: Quick, spar with me! If I gain new insights into Martial Arts, I promise to teach them to you!
10307181.ch: 快找个人来切磋切磋！我要是悟出了功法定会传授与你！

10307191.en: Finally, someone who can see me! Come, come, let's hurry to the tavern and satisfy our thirst. I promise to grant you greater power in return!
10307191.ch: 总算遇到能看见我的人了，来来来，我们快去酒馆解解馋，我定能让你获得更强大的力量！

10307201.en: Stealing mere physical objects no longer interests me. Since fate has brought us together, would you like a glimpse into this supreme art of theft?
10307201.ch: 窃取有形之物已不入我眼，既然有缘你可有意一窥这至高境界？

10307211.en: A deafening roar shakes the world as a mythical beast awakens from its long slumber.
10307211.ch: 一声怒吼响彻天地，被封印的大妖兽复苏了。

10307241.en: O Immortal, my energy is now stored within you! Reject those who would seduce you and be steadfast, and you shall be invincible and able to break through any barrier.
10307241.ch: 仙长，我的灵力已经寄存在你身上了！拒绝那些狂蜂浪蝶，稳住你自己的道心，自然无往不利，无坚不摧。

10307251.en: O Immortal, after I cast my spell, they will tell you all about those lonely, single cultivators.
10307251.ch: 仙长，我施法后，他们就会多跟你聊聊那些孤身寂寞的修士了。

10307261.en: O Immortal, as long as I am here, these cultivators will speak harsh words and spread rumors about their spouses and partners!
10307261.ch: 仙长，只要我在，这些修士就会对他们的夫妻道侣说三道四，冷言冷语！

10307271.en: Everyone I targeted ended up losing something to me. Since fate has brought us together, shall I help you pilfer items from your opponents during battle?
10307271.ch: 被我盯上的人多多少少得留下点东西，既然有缘遇见，在你与人战斗时，可要我助你窃取些许物品来？

10307281.en: O Immortal, debating is a crucial method for self-improvement. Whenever you engage in such debates with others, I shall share secrets that will enhance your innate talents.
10307281.ch: 论道是增长自身素质的重要法门，只要仙长你与旁人论道，我就告诉你一些诀窍，增加你的资质。

10307291.en: While you cultivate in Qi-rich locations, I'll help convert that Qi into Spirit Stones. Two tasks accomplished at once—how's that for efficiency?
10307291.ch: 你在灵气充裕之地修炼，我则帮你转化灵气为灵石，两种功夫，一般的做！

10307301.en: When combat begins, I can ensure your first use of your Domain costs no Tao Power. This technique is extraordinary—do not underestimate its value!
10307301.ch: 触发战斗后，我能保你第一次使用道域时不消耗道力，这妙法神奇非凡，不可轻视！

10307311.en: During auctions, I'll make those wealthy cultivators with plenty of Spirit Stones double their bids until their purses are empty... haha!
10307311.ch: 拍卖之际，我让那些身怀大量灵石的修士尽可能翻倍出价，掏空他们的钱袋，嘿嘿！

10307321.en: After you defeat them, I'll make them drop their most valuable possessions. Oh, how tempting that sounds... hah!
10307321.ch: 打败他们以后，我就让他们身上最值钱的东西掉出来，诱人极了！嘿嘿！

10307331.en: I see you have extraordinary talent—destined to become a legendary hero! So many in the world admire such a figure... Just let me spread the word around.
10307331.ch: 我观道友资质非凡他日必成惊天动地的英豪，八荒中多少人仰慕这样的人物呢，只需要我对外说说即可。

10307341.en: My soul is about to fade away. Our meeting was fated, so let me aid your journey one last time with my Ultimate Skill.
10307341.ch: 我残魂即将消散，相遇一场也是缘分最后以神通助你一程吧。

10307511.en: I can make you irresistibly charming, and everyone will fall for you... heh.
10307511.ch: 我能让你魅力无穷，使人人都喜欢你，嘿嘿嘿。

10307521.en: How dare they attempt to steal from the master thief! I'll teach them a lesson they won't forget.
10307521.ch: 这可真是偷东西偷到老祖宗头上来了，我来给他点教训。

10307531.en: I can pilfer even the sky and the sun with my hands—these are my specialties!
10307531.ch: 偷天换日，移星转斗，就是我的专长！

10307541.en: With my silver tongue and graceful maneuvering, I am the master of mediation!
10307541.ch: 我长袖善舞，口甜舌滑，最会调解！

10307542.en: The relationship between both parties seems to have grown closer.
10307542.ch: 双方关系似乎更融洽了。

10307551.en: With my silver tongue and graceful maneuvering, I am the master of negotiation!
10307551.ch: 我长袖善舞，口甜舌滑，最会周旋！

10307552.en: The relationship with {name|B} seems to have grown closer.
10307552.ch: 与{name|B}的关系似乎更融洽了。

10307561.en: Inspiration strikes! Behold this Martial Art I've crafted just for you!
10307561.ch: 有灵感了！看看我专为你量身打造的功法！

10307571.en: A thousand cups of mellow liquor, a myriad jars of finest wine—I can drink them all in one gulp without breaking a sweat!
10307571.ch: 千盅琼浆，万斤醇酒，一饮而尽，不在话下！

10307581.en: Others are clumsy thieves who only steal possessions. But me? I steal hearts!
10307581.ch: 毛手毛脚，最多偷了旁人的东西。我呢，能偷别人的心！

10307611.en: As humans must learn to refuse others, so must we spirits master this art even more thoroughly.
10307611.ch: 做人要知道怎么拒绝旁人，做鬼更要懂得这个道理。

10307621.en: I can play matchmaker and arrange some connections for you between your family members and acquaintances.
10307621.ch: 你的亲朋好友我可以牵线搭桥。

10307631.en: Whispered words spread like wind, and nothing harms others more easily than rumors.
10307631.ch: 风言风语，最是容易损害旁人。

10307641.en: Ah, the art of debate... When minds clash in verbal combat, there is always much to be learned.
10307641.ch: 论道论道，彼此言语交锋之际，还是有不少可以学习的东西呢。

10307651.en: Spirit Stones and Qi—same essence in different forms. The principle is simple, yet mastering their use... now that's an art.
10307651.ch: 灵石灵气，同质而异形。道理简单，怎么利用却是个学问呢。

10307661.en: Greed is a vice, indeed. But we can still put such vices to good use...
10307661.ch: 贪婪，是不好的。但我们还是能好好利用这些不好的东西……

10307671.en: Hehe, look who's here—your secret admirers have arrived!
10307671.ch: 嘿嘿，仰慕道友的人来喽！

10307681.en: The mystery of my abilities lies within the heart! Using them is one thing, but mastering them is no simple matter.
10307681.ch: 神通之妙，存乎一心！怎么用，怎么用得好，这不是一件简单的事。

10307691.en: Hi, fellow cultivator... I'm happy to meet you here since I will soon lose all of my senses... Please do me a favor.
10307691.ch: 道友请留步…我已经快感应不到任何东西了…庆幸还能遇到道友…还请你帮我一个忙…

10307692.en: My soul will soon dissipate, but I still have a wish. I only remember {2} was a very important person to me, and this {0} was my most prized possession. Would you deliver it to {2}? In return, I'll give you this {1}.
10307692.ch: 我灵魂即将消散…尚有心愿未了…我只记得{2}是对我很重要的人…这{0}是我身前最重要的东西…你可愿帮我带给{2}？ 这{1}愿送与你作为报答…

10307693.en: Thank you... You may learn about {0} at the town tavern...
10307693.ch: 谢谢你…… 在城镇酒馆也许可以打听到{0}的消息…

10307694.en: Alas... No need to feel guilty for me. Perhaps that's my fate...
10307694.ch: 唉…道友不便相助…也是我命该如此…

10307695.en: My soul will soon dissipate, and I leave you this {0}, my most cherished possession... May it serve you well.
10307695.ch: 我灵魂即将消散…这{0}是我身前最重要的东西…就送与你吧…希望能帮到你…

10307697.en: Thank you for keeping your promise... We part ways here. Perhaps in another life, we'll meet again on the path of the way...
10307697.ch: 谢谢你遵守承诺…帮我完成心愿…就此别过…若有来世…再为道友…

10308101.en: This is indeed a rare treasure of heaven and earth. Your kindness touches me, but alas... it has no effect on my second soul. Please, keep it for yourself.
10308101.ch: 此物乃天地奇珍，你有心了，只可惜此物对我这第二元魂无效…此物你好好收着吧

10310001.en: While I've welcomed you into our sect today, you're not quite ready to be my formal disciple. You have two years to dedicate yourself to cultivation and reach the {gradeV|1|A} Realm. Prove your worth, and then we'll talk.
10310001.ch: 尽管今日我已接纳你于门墙之内，但这并不意味着你即刻便能跻身我正式弟子的行列。我赋予你两年时间，望你能以此为契机，潜心修炼，将自身境界提升至{gradeV|1|A}，向我展示你的实力。唯有如此，你方有资格正式成为我的弟子。

10310002.en: You've stagnated for far too long! A disciple like you is a liability. Today, you must be taught a lesson!
10310002.ch: 这么长时间都无法突破，留着你这样的弟子只会败坏我的名声！今日，我必须给你一个教训！

10310003.en: You've been stuck at the {grade|A} Realm for far too long. I expect you to break through to the {gradeV|1|A} Realm soon. Disappoint me, and you'll regret it!
10310003.ch: 徒儿，你停留在{grade|A}已有不少时日了。还望你勤于修炼，早日突破至{gradeV|1|A}，不要给师父丢人！

10310004.en: You've failed to achieve breakthrough for so long... It seems you need to be taught a lesson for neglecting your cultivation!
10310004.ch: 这么长时间都无法突破，看来得给你一些教训，作为懈怠了修炼的惩罚！

10310005.en: {name|A}, you've gone too far! I've always taken it upon myself to purify our sect, yet never did I expect to face such an ungrateful disciple who dares betray my teachings! Today, I shall personally punish those who betray me!
10310005.ch: {name|A}，你竟敢如此胆大妄为！一直以来，皆是我主动清理门户，未曾想今日竟会遭遇你这等胆敢背弃师恩的无知之徒！今日，我必将亲自严惩背叛师门者！

10310006.en: Listen, consider this: {name|C} is a person of exceptional talent and character. Perhaps you two could form a cultivation partnership.
10310006.ch: 孩儿，眼前这位乃是{name|C}，品貌非凡，才情出众。若你心中无碍，不妨深思熟虑，或可考虑与之携手，共结道侣之缘。

10310007.en: I have a {relation|C|B}, {name|C}, who's ready to find a partner. Would you be interested in forming a partnership with my {call|B|C}? Together, you could achieve remarkable things, supporting each other on your journey to greatness!
10310007.ch: 我有一{relation|C|B}，名为{name|C}，年岁渐长，正值寻觅道侣之时。我深知此事重大，故特此相询，不知您是否愿意垂青，与我{call|B|C}共结道侣之好？你们定能心灵相通，修为相长，携手共赴辉煌未来！

10310009.en: {call|A|B}, this is your partner {name|C}, whom I picked for you. May {gender|C} support you on your cultivation journey. Together, you could achieve remarkable things, supporting each other on your journey to greatness.
10310009.ch: {call|A|B}，这便是我为你挑选的伴侣{name|C}，愿{gender|C}能成为你修真路上的坚实后盾。望你们二人能够心心相印，携手并肩，让未来之路因彼此的陪伴而更加灿烂夺目。

10310010.en: Hmph! I never expected such insolence from you! Today, I'll teach you a lesson you won't soon forget!
10310010.ch: 哼！没想到你竟如此不识抬举！今日，若不给你点颜色瞧瞧，实难平我心头之愤！

10310011.en: I am eternally grateful for your mercy in vanquishing {0}, ending our long-standing enmity. I shall cherish your kindness forever! Let us seize this opportunity to forge an unbreakable bond of brotherhood. Together, we shall face the trials ahead, support one another, and ascend to greatness.
10310011.ch: 多谢你出手杀了{0}，让我从与{0}的宿怨中彻底解脱。这份恩情，我铭记于心！我们能否借此机缘，结为异姓兄弟，共同面对未来的风雨，相互扶持，共谋大业？

10310012.en: {name|A}, after tireless pursuit, I have finally discovered {name|C}'s hiding place. If you are free from pressing matters, let us join forces and eliminate that vile creature.
10310012.ch: {name|A}，近日我经过一番周折，终于探得了{name|C}的行踪！若你此时手头无甚紧要之事，何不与我一同去剿灭这厮？

10310013.en: I implore you to show compassion and spare my life. If you grant me this mercy, I pledge my unwavering loyalty. I shall become your partner, serving you faithfully until the end of days.
10310013.ch: 请高抬贵手，绕我一命。若你今日放了我，我愿以身相许，成为你的道侣，倾尽余生之力，侍奉左右，不离不弃。

10310014.en: {name|A}, if you do not surrender {0} immediately, I shall end my own life before your very eyes!
10310014.ch: {name|A}，今日你若不将{0}交给我，我立马就死在你面前！

10310015.en: The other day, I heard a cry for help deep within the Fallen Valley.
10310015.ch: 日前我听到陨幽谷深处，有一个声音在求救。

10310016.en: Are you sure you didn't mishear? I've been exploring there recently and haven't heard anything.
10310016.ch: 你是不是听错了？我最近进入查探啥都没听见。

10310017.en: No, really. I heard them cry out for help.

10310018.en: I think your cultivation must have gone to your head.
10310018.ch: 我觉得你是修炼走火了吧？

10310019.en: Nonsense! If my cultivation had really gone wrong, would I dare venture into the Fallen Valley?
10310019.ch: 走你个头！我走火还敢跑到陨幽谷中冒险吗？

10310020.en: You must have seen a ghost or something.

10310021.en: Hm, there really are strange sounds here.

10310023.en: Ahead, a woman slumps against the mountainside. She reaches out with a trembling arm, her voice barely a whisper.
10310023.ch: 前方一个女子，倚在山壁瘫坐地上，她发出虚弱的声音，抬起一条手臂无力地向你伸来。

10310024.en: The woman before you has porcelain-like skin and is strikingly beautiful. However, upon closer inspection, you notice mechanical joints around her eyes, jaw, and all over her body—devices that allow her to move. Rather than a human, she appears more like an exquisite puppet...
10310024.ch: 眼前女子肤若凝脂，面目绝美。但眼眸下颚，身上各处关节均设有咬合装置，以供躯体活动。面前女子与其说是一个人类，倒更像一具木偶……

10310025.en: There are monsters nearby with soul fragments attached to them... Please... bring some to me, so I can restore my damaged soul...
10310025.ch: 这附近有一些怪物，身上附有一些残灵，请……给我找来一些，让我恢复破损的神识……

10310026.en: Thank you... If not for your help, my soul would have dissipated...
10310026.ch: 多谢……亏得你帮忙，神识才没有散去……

10310027.en: The "woman" offers her thanks, but her face remains completely devoid of emotion. Cradling her injured arm, she stumbles forward, seemingly intent on leaving this place...
10310027.ch: 眼前这“女子”嘴里道谢，但只脸上却不见半分情绪，她一手护着受伤的手臂，蹒跚前行，似乎要离开此处……

10310028.en: Would you... take me... to this place...
10310028.ch: 可否请你……将我送到这里……

10310029.en: The "woman" raises her finger and traces delicate lines on the ground. The earth responds to her touch, materializing into a detailed map of Hua Feng. She pauses at a spot between the mountains, pressing down to create a small indent that marks her destination...
10310029.ch: “女子”竖起手指将地上轻轻描画，地上顿时显现山河地理，观之却是华封州的地图。她用手指在某处山间一顿，按出了一个小凹陷，标明了目的地所在……

10310030.en: You escort {name|B} to a hillside. It's a picturesque spot surrounded by towering trees, with a massive boulder that sits like a paperweight on the landscape. She glances at you, seemingly uncertain, then gives you a small bow before slowly making her way to settle beneath the great stone.
10310030.ch: 你将{name|B}送到一处山冈上，此地风光秀冶，周围大树参天，不远处一块巨石纸镇一般压住。她看了看你，似乎有些不知所措，只得朝你躬身点了点头，便慢慢走到那大石下栖身。

10310031.en: I'm fine... yet not so fine...

10310032.en: I can manage... Thank you for leading me away...
10310032.ch: 我可以的……多谢你带我离开……

10310034.en: As {name|B} speaks, her left arm makes a mechanical clicking sound when she moves it as if something is blocking its movement. She swiftly gathers dead grass with her right hand, weaving it into bundles. In mere moments, she assembles them into a small lean-to against the rock for shelter. Huddled beneath it, she begins tracing patterns in the dirt with her finger—what appears to be architectural blueprints...
10310034.ch: {name|B}说这话时，活动了一下左手，发出咔咔的响，仿佛有什么阻碍了手臂活动。当下便用右手将地上一些衰草打成小结一个一个的放好，但只眨眼间即结成一个檐篷支在石上，为自己遮风挡雨……她自己则蜷缩在檐篷下用手指画出一个个图案，似乎是某些建筑的构造图谱……

10310035.en: {name|B} pays no attention to you. Her pupils are dilated as she remains completely absorbed in sketching some peculiar structure...
10310035.ch: {name|B}没有理会你，她瞳孔放大，似在聚精会神地描绘着某种特殊建筑……

10310036.en: After your question, {name|B} gives a resigned smile, a hint of sorrow showing through her dull eyes...
10310036.ch: 你问了这话后，{name|B}无奈地笑了笑，呆滞的眼神之中透出一股哀伤，……

10310037.en: I don't even know what I truly am. But I know I'm different from you... Perhaps I'm just a failed creation...
10310037.ch: 我也不知道我究竟是什么？但我和你是不一样的……也许我只是一具失败的造物……

10310039.en: When you return, {name|B} is still drawing in the dirt with her one hand. The ground is now covered with sketches of various architectural designs.
10310039.ch: 你再次来到此地，{name|B}仍在依靠单手在地上描绘图谱，但现在已经画满林林种种的各式房屋的样式

10310041.en: A house... The Origin Box is a house...

10310043.en: You... want to help me? But... there's nothing you can do for me...
10310043.ch: 你……愿意帮我？但是……没有你能帮我的……

10310044.en: This is a token of gratitude... Thank you for helping me before.
10310044.ch: 这是谢礼……多谢你之前帮我。

10310045.en: When you return, {name|B} is still drawing in the dirt with her one hand. Now she's sketching an arm, meticulously detailing every bone, tendon, and anatomical feature with remarkable precision.
10310045.ch: 你再次来到此地，{name|B}仍在依靠单手在地上描绘图谱。目下她正在描画一只手臂，当中骨骼筋腱，诸般细节，纤毫毕现。

10310046.en: Her shelter has clearly grown larger, now providing better protection from the elements. Beneath it lies a collection of simple tools and objects she's crafted from dead grass and stones, each seemingly made for a specific purpose...
10310046.ch: 但显然她头顶的檐篷变得更为广大，似已能遮风挡雨。檐篷下方堆着不少不少用衰草石头简易制作的东西，似乎别用用途……

10310047.en: My arm, I can't move it... Must fix it...

10310048.en: I cannot enter the Fallen Valley now. Would you please help me find some Earthly and Heavenly Materials... I need them...
10310048.ch: 现在，我无法进入陨幽谷，可否请你替我找些缝坤乳和凝乾乳来……我需要这些东西……

10310049.en: I need Earthly Materials and Heavenly Materials...
10310049.ch: 我需要缝坤乳和凝乾乳……

10310050.en: {name|B} takes the item you brought her. She glances at you briefly before turning her head away shyly...
10310050.ch: {name|B}接过你为她找来的东西，然后看了看你，又害羞似的偏过了头……

10310051.en: Thank you... Now... I should be able to repair this arm...
10310051.ch: 谢谢你……这下……应该可以修好手臂了……

10310052.en: You catch a glimpse of what seems to be the faintest smile on {name|B}'s face. But she quickly returns to her drawings, becoming absorbed in her work once more...
10310052.ch: 你好像看见{name|B}露出一个难以察觉的笑容。但她马上又埋首勾画图谱，没再理会你……

10310053.en: When you return to {name|B}'s dwelling, you find a simple house has been built there. At first, there's no sign of anyone around. Suddenly, a graceful figure flits past, and {name|B} appears before you. With a bright smile, she raises her left hand and presents you with a curious little trinket.
10310053.ch: 你再次来到{name|B}栖身的地方时，发现这边已经搭建起一所简陋的房子。然则周围却不见人影。就在此时，倩影掠过，{name|B}已现身面前。她笑盈盈的抬起左手，将一个奇特的小玩意送到你面前。

10310055.en: Yes, thanks to you bringing me the adhesives, this arm can finally move properly again.
10310055.ch: 嗯，亏得你给我找来粘合之物，这才能让这条手臂重新活动起来。

10310056.en: This is for you. I've noticed that people here like to express goodwill by giving gifts to each other. Thank you for going through the trouble of finding the materials for me.
10310056.ch: 这是送给你的，我看你们这里的人喜欢赠送东西给对方表达善意。多谢你替我奔走，找来缝坤乳和凝乾乳。

10310057.en: As you fiddle with the trinket, you accidentally trigger some mechanism. In an instant, the entire ornament comes apart, transforming into several exquisite treasures...
10310057.ch: 你试着把玩这件小玩意。期间不知道拨动了什么关键，整个小道具倏然散落，化为好些精致宝物……

10310058.en: I hope to construct the Origin Box, so I can fully fix myself.
10310058.ch: 我希望搭建归元木匣，这样就能完整修复我自己。

10310059.en: Would you... help me? My arm seems to be working fine now, so I'll try to go out and search for materials to construct the Origin Box.
10310059.ch: 你愿意……帮我吗？我的手臂似乎已经无碍，接下来我会试着外出寻找材料，搭建归元木匣。

10310060.en: The Origin Box can let me rest, restore my energy, and repair my injuries... As for me, I hope to discover its secrets, so I can break free from this body...
10310060.ch: 归元木匣可以让我休息，恢复灵力，修复我身上的损伤……而我，希望能找到当中的秘密，让我摆脱这个身躯……

10310061.en: What am I... Everyone else is a perfect creation of heaven's grand design. But I... I am probably just a failed work...
10310061.ch: 我是什么……每个人都是这苍天大化的完美造物。而我，大概只是一件失败的作品……

10310062.en: Though {name|B} had seemed quite cheerful before, your words cast a shadow over her mood, leaving her visibly dejected. Seeing you have nothing more to say, she retreats into the house and begins drawing on the ground once more.
10310062.ch: 眼前的{name|B}本已颇为开朗，但这话说过后，似乎又被阴翳笼罩，变得忧郁失落，{name|B}见你无话，便又跑到房子之中，在地上勾画什么图谱。

10310063.en: When you return to {name|B}'s dwelling, you find the once-simple house has been renovated, now bearing a subtle elegance. However, {name|B} seems to be out, and the house stands empty.
10310063.ch: 你再次来到{name|B}栖身之处，眼前简陋的房屋已经过一番修缮，变得颇具雅韵。然则{name|B}似乎外出未归，屋中空无一人。

10310064.en: Inside, you find only a bed, a table, and several locked storage cabinets that seem to hide some mysterious mechanism. There's also a sand table on the desk—as you approach it, the grains of sand begin to shift and ripple, gradually taking on human-like forms.
10310064.ch: 只见内屋之中只有一塌一案，以及若干收藏用的柜子，这些柜子似乎内藏玄机，均以锁扣封住。此外另有沙盘放置案上，你一旦靠近，上面砂砾起伏，隐隐幻化人形。

10310065.en: Incredibly, the human figure on the sand table begins to speak.
10310065.ch: 沙盘中人形竟然发出声响。

10310066.en: Though constructed as a wooden puppet, the Guardian Handmaiden possesses eight thousand minor channels and three thousand major pathways, with internal meridians and tendons surrounding organs just like a human being. She was originally created to serve as a loyal protector, defending her master from danger.
10310066.ch: 护法侍女虽为木偶构造，但身开八千小窍，三千中窍，体内脉络筋腱环于脏器，实与常人无异。制作的初衷乃为忠于主人，为其护法，抵御危机所用。

10310067.en: While the Origin Box appears to be the Guardian Handmaiden's dwelling, it is in fact a workshop for studying her construction. The wooden bed serves as a repair station, the cabinets store spare parts, and the sand table on the desk is used to analyze puppet mechanisms.
10310067.ch: 归元木匣看似护法侍女的居所，实为研究侍女的工房，其木榻可作修复之用，木柜则藏纳替补零件。案台沙盘则可推演木偶构造。

10310068.en: The puppet is merely the first step of the experiment. The true hope lies in successfully transforming wood into flesh.
10310068.ch: 木偶仅为第一步试验，希望将之变木为人能够成功。

10310069.en: Suddenly, a scream pierces the air from afar—it sounds like {name|B}'s voice.
10310069.ch: 此时远方传来一声尖叫，听着似为{name|B}所发。

10310070.en: Well, little girl, you're quite an unusual sight. Just what kind of creature are you?
10310070.ch: 小姑娘，你长得倒是挺别致的，你究竟是个什么东西？

10310072.en: No, I won't let you go until I figure you out today. Why don't you come to my residence? Let me examine what manner of thing you really are.
10310072.ch: 不，今天不搞明白，我不会放开，不如到我洞府之中，让我好生研究研究，你究竟是个什么玩意吧？

10310073.en: Little girl, you don't know about Dual Cultivation in your life, do you? I'll teach you everything and show you the most wonderful experience under heaven!
10310073.ch: 小姑娘，你不知道什么是性命双修吧？这一切我都教你，叫你知道天底下最美妙的滋味！

10310074.en: A cultivator lets out a sinister laugh as he grabs {name|B}, whose eyes widen with surprise.
10310074.ch: 一名修士桀桀的笑，他抓住{name|B}，她眼中充满了惊讶。

10310075.en: Where did you come from? How dare you interfere with my business?
10310075.ch: 哪来的人，也敢来碍我的事？

10310078.en: He... he grabbed me, I broke free, but he kept chasing me... All the way here... What should I do?
10310078.ch: 他……他抓住我，我挣脱了，还一直追着我……一直追到这边……我该怎么做？

10310080.en: Though confusion flashes across {name|B}'s face, your words spur her to action. Her hands strike like twin blades as she elegantly swings her arm, wounding the cultivator's wrist.
10310080.ch: {name|B}脸现疑惑之色，但听了你这话后，骈掌如刀，藕臂轻挥，竟将那修士手腕打伤。

10310081.en: Ah, great mistress, I was wrong! My foolish nose failed to smell your true power. I was wrong! Please spare me!
10310081.ch: 哎呦，姑奶奶，我错了！是我当康鼻子没嗅着姑奶奶的真香，我错啦！饶了我吧！

10310082.en: {name|B} hesitates, but after glancing at you, she brings her foot down, wounding the cultivator's leg in an instant...
10310082.ch: {name|B}一脸犹豫，但看了看你后，莲足一跺，当场将修士的腿踩伤……

10310083.en: Ah! Great cultivator, I was wrong! This lowly one failed to recognize the noble lady before him and offended your presence! Spare me! Spare me!
10310083.ch: 啊！女大能，我错了！小的有眼不识泰山，冒犯了尊颜！饶了我！饶了我！

10310084.en: Thoroughly terrified, the person scrambles away as soon as {name|B} releases him, dragging his injured body as he flees in panic.
10310084.ch: 那人吓得不轻，{name|B}放开此人，立即拖着受伤的身体，屁滚尿流的跑了。

10310085.en: Is this the right way? I... I've never been sure how to handle these situations. It feels too harsh, but I've seen other cultivators beat people up badly when driving them away.
10310085.ch: 是这样吗？我……一直拿不准是不是应该这样，好像太狠了，但是我上次看见别的修士赶走别人就是将人狠狠的打了一顿。

10310086.en: I also think letting him go is better. I didn't know there were so many ways to drive someone away.
10310086.ch: 我也觉得是放走比较好，原来赶走还有这么多意思啊？

10310087.en: Yes, I also think it's better to spare him. It's just a bit...
10310087.ch: 是，我也是觉得饶过他比较好。就是这样比较

10310088.en: Huh? How can someone be so petty? He offended me first, and I hadn't even gotten angry, yet he's the one holding a grudge? Sigh. Dealing with humans is truly headache-inducing.
10310088.ch: 啊？这么小气的吗？他先冒犯的我，我还没生气，他倒记恨起来了？唉，和人相处可真叫人头疼。

10310089.en: Oh, so this is what they call "an eye for an eye"? If someone treats me badly, I treat them badly in return. And if you treat me well, I must treat you well too!
10310089.ch: 噢，这就叫以牙还牙啊？别人对我不好我就对别人不好。你对我好！我也要对你好！

10310090.en: Alas. I always hoped everyone could live in perfect harmony without fighting or arguing, but it seems... that's impossible after all.
10310090.ch: 唉，我总盼望大家能够和和美美的，不要打架，不要吵架，不过看来啊，是不可能的了。

10310092.en: Though usually wearing an expression of complete bewilderment, {name|B}'s eyes now hold an inexplicably profound and mysterious gleam as she speaks these words...
10310092.ch: 总是满脸迷茫之色的{name|B}说完这话，不知为何眼中却透出一股深邃难明的意味来……

10310093.en: My deepest gratitude, mighty master! A thousand thanks!

10310094.en: Hm? Aren't you going to thank me too?

10310095.en: Thank you, great mistress! May you enjoy eternal celestial blessings and live as long as the heavens themselves!
10310095.ch: 多谢姑奶奶，姑奶奶仙福永享，寿与天齐！

10310096.en: Thoroughly terrified, the man scrambles away as soon as {name|B} releases him, dragging his injured body as he flees in panic.
10310096.ch: 那人吓得不轻，{name|B}放开了他，立即拖着受伤的身体，屁滚尿流的跑了。

10310097.en: The Origin Box has been improved since your last visit, with {name|B} constantly working on expanding the structure.
10310097.ch: 与上次来时相比，归元木匣又得到改善，旁边{name|B}正在不断扩建房屋。

10310098.en: Oh, you're here? Could you please watch over my house? I need to go out and find something.
10310098.ch: 你来啦？可以拜托你看一下房子吗？我得外出找个东西。

10310099.en: {name|B} gives you an innocent smile before turning to leave, but moments later, a scream pierces the air from afar...
10310099.ch: {name|B}对你傻傻的一笑，然后转身离开，但没过多久远方即传来一声尖叫……

10310100.en: You follow the scream to find {name|B} staring down at a cultivator on the ground, her face filled with surprise...
10310100.ch: 你循声找到{name|B}，只见她满脸惊讶看着地上一个修士……

10310102.en: Ah... it hurts, it hurts so much! Little girl, wasn't that a bit too brutal?
10310102.ch: 啊……好痛好痛，小姑娘，你手下太狠了吧？

10310103.en: I... I was outside looking for something I needed when this person grabbed my shoulder... I got scared, and so I just...
10310103.ch: 我……我在外寻找需要的东西，这人抓住了我的肩膀……我害怕，于是就……

10310104.en: Listen, little girl... I saw you were looking for this item, right? I brought it for you. I was trying to get your attention, but you seemed like you couldn't hear me... so I just tapped your shoulder.
10310104.ch: 小姑娘……我是看你在找这个东西吧？给你拿来了，我在跟你招呼，你好像又听不见……这才拍一下你。

10310105.en: Huh? I... what should I do now? Should I break his legs too?
10310105.ch: 啊？我……这可怎么办？我还要把这人的脚也打断吗？

10310106.en: What?! Hey, hey! What's going on?! Why would you want to break my legs too?!
10310106.ch: 哈？喂喂？搞什么？为什么还要打断我的脚？

10310107.en: Oh, so that means he wasn't trying to harm me, right?
10310107.ch: 哦，那就是说，他不是对我图谋不轨，对吗？

10310108.en: Pah! Harming you? I was just trying to help by bringing you something!
10310108.ch: 呸！什么图谋不轨，我是好心给你找来东西。

10310109.en: I'm sorry... You meant no harm, so... should I leave now?
10310109.ch: 对不起……你没有恶意，那我先走了？

10310110.en: What? You're just going to leave me here like this?
10310110.ch: 啊？你就把我落在这里了？

10310111.en: Well... what else would I do?

10310112.en: Treat the injury? Do you mean reattaching the leg? Shouldn't we first remove the entire leg for a thorough inspection before reattaching it?
10310112.ch: 治伤？是指把腿接上吗？应该先把腿整条拆掉好好检查，才好接上吧？

10310113.en: {name|B} approaches the cultivator, her hands hovering eagerly as if wanting to tear off the person's legs just to reattach them...
10310113.ch: {name|B}凑近那名修士，双手虚抓，一副跃跃欲试，要上前将修士双腿撕了再重新接上的样子……

10310114.en: Whoa! Don't touch me! Friend, could you please bring me two G4 Blood Circulation Elixir? Once I take them and let the medicine work, I should heal... As for this esteemed lady, please show mercy and spare me!
10310114.ch: 喂喂喂！你别动！朋友，可否请你给我带两瓶四品活血丹。我服下运化药力，当能痊愈……至于这位姑奶奶还是高抬贵手吧！

10310115.en: I know about good elixir and bad elixir, but what kind of elixir is Blood Simulation Elixir?
10310115.ch: 鸡蛋鸭蛋我知道，或许蛋是什么？

10310116.en: Not simulation! I mean Blood Circulation Elixir! Young lady, please step back a bit... three steps—no, make that thirty steps away from me!
10310116.ch: 不是或许蛋，是活血丹！姑娘你走远一些，离我三步，不三十步！

10310118.en: Thank you, fellow cultivator! I am deeply grateful!

10310119.en: You're healed already? Why aren't you leaving then? Come here and let me check—if it's not done right, I can tear off your legs and reattach them!
10310119.ch: 这就治好了？那你还不快走？走来看看呀，不行我扯断你的腿再给接上！

10310120.en: No, no, no! I'm leaving! I'm leaving right now!

10310121.en: Why is he so scared? Actually... did I do something wrong? I shouldn't have hurt him, right? What should I have done instead?
10310121.ch: 他为啥这么害怕？其实，我是不是做错了事？我不该打伤他，是不是？我该怎么做？

10310122.en: I know I made a mistake... I really regret not tearing off his legs to fix them properly. Maybe I should have taken off his head too, just to check if his brain was injured.
10310122.ch: 我知道是我错了……我真后悔没扯断他的腿给他补上，可能还得把他头摘下来看看脑袋有没有撞着。

10310123.en: But I'm starting to feel that he and I are quite different. Perhaps... my methods of healing wouldn't work on him at all? Oh dear, I feel so guilty...
10310123.ch: 不过我总感觉他和我是不太一样的。应该，我的治疗手段对他是行不通的吧？哎呀，好内疚……

10310124.en: To apologize... does that mean I should openly admit my mistakes?
10310124.ch: 道歉，是不是就坦白说出自己的错误？

10310125.en: I'm sorry. Having you here makes me feel at ease. When I go out and make trouble, you can help me... Ah! I don't mean to dump my problems on you. I'm so sorry!
10310125.ch: 那我对不起你。你来了我很安心，我出去闯祸了，你也能帮我……啊！我不是要把事情甩给你的意思。我对不起你！

10310126.en: {name|B} watches the cultivator gradually disappear into the distance, guilt written all over her face...
10310126.ch: {name|B}看着逐渐离开的修士，脸上现出内疚的神情……

10310127.en: I came out to find a small treasure, and now that I've found it, I'm heading back! Will you... will you come visit again? I'll make my home nice and welcoming for you.
10310127.ch: 我出来是找个小宝物的，这下找到了，我回去了！你，你还会来吗？我会把家里弄得好好的招待你。

10310128.en: I was wrong, I should have properly examined his injuries! Here's what we'll do: first I'll tear off your legs, and since you fell earlier, you might have hit your head too, so I'll remove your head for inspection as well!
10310128.ch: 这是我不对，我应该好好给他检查伤患的！这样吧，我先把你的腿撕下来，刚刚你摔倒地上，可能头也撞着了，我把你头也摘下来检查检查！

10310144.en: Huh? But I did it on purpose. Last time, someone tried to get handsy with me, so I thought he would do the same thing, that's why I hit him!
10310144.ch: 啊？可我是故意的。上回那个人就是对我动手动脚的，我以为他也要这么干，所以就打了他！

10310145.en: Actually, I was thinking of giving him another kick to cripple him, so he wouldn't be able to chase after me.
10310145.ch: 其实我当时还想再补上一脚，把他打伤，这样他就没办法追着我了。

10310146.en: What? See! She did it on purpose!
10310146.ch: 啊？你看你看！她是故意的！

10310147.en: Alright, I'll stop talking. Actually, I do feel quite guilty about taking you down so easily...
10310147.ch: 好吧，我不说了。其实一动手就把你打成这样，我也是很内疚的……

10310148.en: What! Are you calling me a pushover?
10310148.ch: 啊！你在说我不堪一击吗？

10310149.en: No, that's not it! I meant I feel guilty about hurting you!
10310149.ch: 不、不是，我的意思是把你打伤，我很内疚！

10310150.en: Yes, I'm sorry. I shouldn't have taken you down so quickly with just one strike.
10310150.ch: 是，对不起，我不该一出手就把你打成这样的。

10310151.en: What's that supposed to mean! Are you saying I was too weak to defend myself?
10310151.ch: 你什么意思！你是说我太弱了，所以才挡不住吗？

10310152.en: That's not what I... Oh dear, it seems like everything I say comes out wrong...
10310152.ch: 不是的……哎呀，好像怎么说都会说错……

10310153.en: Um, shouldn't we focus on helping him instead?
10310153.ch: 这个，我们还是帮帮他好吗？

10310168.en: {name|B} watches the cultivator gradually disappear into the distance, guilt written in her eyes...
10310168.ch: {name|B}看着逐渐离开的修士，眼中透出内疚的神情……

10310170.en: When you arrive at {name|B}'s residence, you find her Origin Box has grown even more intricate, with numerous expansions added to the structure. What was once a humble abode has become quite substantial. The house is empty at the moment—{name|B} is likely out searching for treasures to further improve her home.
10310170.ch: 你来到{name|B}住处时，归元木匣又已变得更加复杂，多处地方已得到扩建，原本简陋的房屋已颇具规模。其时房屋之中空无一人，估计{name|B}又到外面寻找宝物继续完善居所。

10310171.en: You stir the sand in the divination table, watching as the fine grains rise and fall, taking on human shapes...
10310171.ch: 你拨弄沙盘，那里面细沙起伏，幻作人形……

10310172.en: I want the Guardian Handmaiden to be more than just a puppet—she should be a person with genuine emotions and consciousness.
10310172.ch: 我希望护法侍女不单单只是一具木偶，她应该是一个拥有情感意识的人。

10310173.en: Following this concept in her design, the Handmaiden quickly developed the ability to read others' emotions. Through various encounters, she gradually learned to experience feelings of her own.
10310173.ch: 依照这个想法，进行设计，侍女很快就有了揣摩旁人情绪的能力。她遇事后能慢慢学会体会感情。

10310174.en: Recently, she apologized to me for a minor incident and even felt genuine guilt about it. She's also learned various social graces from me. What's truly surprising is how quickly she picks up these things.
10310174.ch: 近日她因为一件小事向我道歉，她还感到内疚。她还从我这里学会了一些人情世故。让人吃惊的是，她学习能力真的很强。

10310175.en: Interesting. I've expanded the functions of the Origin Box, hoping to further perfect the Handmaiden.
10310175.ch: 有意思，我扩展了归元木匣的功能，希望能进一步完善侍女。

10310176.en: You're here! Wonderful! The Origin Box is missing one component, and as luck would have it, someone got that very thing at an auction.
10310176.ch: 你来啦！真好！归元木匣的建造缺了一个东西，恰好有个人从拍卖会中得到了那玩意。

10310177.en: Could you help me get that item? The person is near the city. I thought about breaking his legs to make him wait for us, but then I worried that isn't right. It might also cause a misunderstanding!
10310177.ch: 你能不能帮我把东西弄来？那个人主城附近，我本想敲断他的腿让他等着，但好像这是不对的，还会引起误会！

10310178.en: I've been waiting for you. If you want this thing, you'll need to trade for it. I want 1,000 Spirit Stones plus two Wind Essence Bamboos.
10310178.ch: 我等着呢，你想要那玩意就得拿东西来换。我要1000灵石，外加两个精风竹。

10310179.en: This is the one. He won't give me the item unless I provide these things. What should I do?
10310179.ch: 就是这位，他要这些才肯将东西给我。我该怎么办？

10310180.en: Oh, I get it now. This fellow wants to exchange items, right?
10310180.ch: 哦，我明白了，这家伙是要交换东西对吧？

10310181.en: What do I want? I just want this treasure... so I'll just take it, okay?
10310181.ch: 我想怎样？我就是想要这件宝物……那我拿了啊？

10310182.en: Before you or the cultivator can react, {name|B} reaches out—and the item is already in her hands...
10310182.ch: {name|B}一探，你和那修士还没反应过来，东西已在{name|B}手中……

10310183.en: What? You're planning to rob me? Do you have a death wish?
10310183.ch: 啊？这是要抢我的东西？不要命了是吗？

10310184.en: Our paths will cross again—you better remember that!
10310184.ch: 山水有相逢，你给我记着！

10310185.en: Why was he so angry? I just wanted that treasure, that's all. Don't cultivators always say material possessions are meaningless? Though... I'm starting to feel like maybe this isn't quite right...
10310185.ch: 为什么他这么凶，我只是想要那宝物而已啊。修士不都说，那都是身外之物吗？嗯，虽然我也总感觉好像不太好的样子……

10310186.en: Wait, isn't this what they call robbery? Yes... robbery is wrong!
10310186.ch: 这是不是叫抢夺？嗯，抢夺不是好事！

10310187.en: I see. But I've noticed other cultivators like to strike without warning. If we tell him first, he might prepare defenses.
10310187.ch: 这样子啊。但我看其他修士都喜欢出其不意出手，跟你说了，指不定他就有防备了。

10310188.en: But... isn't that wrong? Something about this feels very wrong...
10310188.ch: 这样是不是不好？我总感觉不太对劲。

10310189.en: {name|B} seems to have many more questions, but suddenly voices come from the roadside. Upon hearing them, her expression shifts to one of intense focus...
10310189.ch: {name|B}似乎还要询问很多东西，此时道旁忽然传来人语，{name|B}听到后流露专注之色……

10310191.en: Then what should I do? Tell me... whatever you wish... I'll do anything you say...
10310191.ch: 那要怎样？你说，依你，都依你……

10310194.en: Are they sparring? But it doesn't sound like it... they're speaking so tenderly...
10310194.ch: 比试切磋？怎么听起来不像，他们说话好温柔……

10310195.en: But... she said it hurts... No, this won't do! I must check on them!
10310195.ch: 可是……她说痛……不行，我得看看！

10310196.en: {name|B} tiptoes forward and peers around a patch of grass, where she spots a man and woman nestled together in a loving embrace, lost in their tender moment.
10310196.ch: {name|B}蹑足前行，转过一片草丛，却见一男一女相依相偎，你侬我侬，十分亲热。

10310197.en: It was just a little kiss, how could that hurt?
10310197.ch: 我就亲了一下，怎么就痛？

10310198.en: Tee-hee! I was just teasing you. I love seeing you all worried like that.
10310198.ch: 噗呲，骗你的，我喜欢看你着急的样子。

10310199.en: Hmph, you'll be seeing plenty more of that in the future.

10310200.en: Really? Forever and always? All things begin with passion, but few endure to the end, so don't make promises you can't keep.
10310200.ch: 真的吗？以后都有？靡不有初，鲜克有终，你可不要说大话了。

10310201.en: You don't believe me? I'll give you my heart—see for yourself!
10310201.ch: 你不信？我把心交给你，你自己看好了！

10310202.en: As the couple draws closer together, whispering sweet nothings to each other, {name|B} suddenly leaps out and forces them apart...
10310202.ch: 两人说着，慢慢凑到一起交头接耳，{name|B}突然纵身而上分开二人……

10310203.en: No, stop! How could you dig out your heart to give to her? You'll die if you do that!
10310203.ch: 不可以！你怎能把自己的心脏挖出来给她？这样你会死的！

10310204.en: The couple's faces, previously flushed with passion, turn pale at this sudden intrusion. The woman looks utterly displeased while the man curses under his breath at {name|B}. Within moments, both storm off in anger...
10310204.ch: 两人原本满脸通红，见此突变，顿时脸都青了，那女的一脸不快，男的则对{name|B}骂骂咧咧的，眨眼间两人都悻悻地离开了……

10310205.en: Huh? Why are they scolding me? They're... they're putting their mouths together... what are they doing?
10310205.ch: 咦？他为什么骂我？他们他们好像要拿嘴巴凑到对方嘴巴上……这是干嘛？

10310206.en: What? W-why are they trying to eat each other's mouths?
10310206.ch: 啊？为……为什么要吃掉对方嘴巴？

10310207.en: I... I have a feeling they're doing this because of some special emotion...
10310207.ch: 我……我总觉得他们好像是因为一种特别的心情才做出这样的举动……

10310208.en: Ah! I get it now! Sometimes you have something on your mind, but you're too shy to say it out loud!
10310208.ch: 啊！对了，我发现你们有时候心里有事，却扭扭捏捏不愿意说出口！

10310209.en: So that's when you bite each other's mouths and everyone understands without words? I get it, I get it!
10310209.ch: 这时候是不是去啃一下对方嘴巴就大家都心照不宣了？懂了懂了！

10310210.en: But... but why did that man say he'd dig out his heart? Does... does that woman like eating hearts?
10310210.ch: 那……那为什么那男的说要把自己的心脏挖出来？是……那个女的喜欢吃心脏吗？

10310211.en: Oh? This man must really like this woman, right? He's even willing to dig out his heart for her.
10310211.ch: 啊？这男的一定很喜欢这女的吧？都愿意把自己心脏挖出来给他了。

10310212.en: I understand now! He was speaking metaphorically! He means he's willing to give everything of himself to her!
10310212.ch: 我懂了！这男的是打了个比方！他的意思是能把自己一切都交给对方！

10310213.en: People's thoughts are so hard to understand... What they say and what they mean can be such different things...
10310213.ch: 人们的心思可真难揣摩……说着的是一套，实则却又是另外一套……

10310214.en: I've got what I need. Now I must head back to build my house! Thank you for your help!
10310214.ch: 东西拿到了，我还要先回去建房子呢！多谢你来帮我！

10310215.en: {name|B}'s expression remains puzzled as she taps her temple with her knuckle, then lets out a soft sigh before slowly walking away.
10310215.ch: {name|B}透出一脸懵懂之色，她用食指关节扣了下太阳穴，这才叹息一声慢慢离开了。

10310216.en: {name|B} peeks secretly from behind a flower bush, where she spots a man and woman pouring their hearts out to each other.
10310216.ch: {name|B}正在一处花丛中偷偷探头张望，只见花丛外是一对男女正互诉衷肠。

10310217.en: Hmm... do they... love each other? What a strange feeling this is...
10310217.ch: 唔……他们是……喜欢对方吗？好特别的感觉……

10310218.en: {name|B} watches the loving couple ahead, her cheeks growing pink. Her expressions shift constantly—now a smile, now a frown—cycling through a spectrum of emotions.
10310218.ch: {name|B}看着前方二人卿卿我我，脸上泛起晕红。她时而微笑，时而愁烦，各种表情，不一而足。

10310219.en: Through {name|B}'s diligent efforts, her Origin Box has grown magnificent—its eaves sweep outward like wings, its roof peaks reaching skyward in an increasingly grand display.
10310219.ch: 只见归元木匣在{name|B}辛勤营建下，飞檐伸展，鹤顶朝天已渐有豪华之势。

10310220.en: The fine sand in the divination table rises and falls like golden waterfalls, forming a human shape that speaks with measured confidence.
10310220.ch: 沙盘之中细沙起伏，如金砂如流瀑，一个人形从中显现，并侃侃而谈。

10310221.en: The Guardian Handmaiden's transformation has gradually exceeded my expectations.
10310221.ch: “护法侍女的变化已渐渐超乎我的想象。”

10310222.en: As she observes those around her, a deep sadness shows in her eyes. She seems to see her own fate reflected in their experiences.
10310222.ch: “她看着身边的人事，眼中常常透出哀伤。似乎她从旁人的经历之中推测出自己的命运。”

10310223.en: As the fox grieves for the rabbit, all beings mourn their kind. Yes, this is the feeling she gives me.
10310223.ch: “兔死狐悲，物伤其类。不错，她给我这种感觉。”

10310224.en: She has begun to think for herself, developing her own ideas. Though she still puts my wishes first, she now takes moments to contemplate before acting.
10310224.ch: “她开始自己思考，做事也有了自己的想法。虽然她万事以我为先，但事前总是略作沉思。”

10310225.en: She now considers everything carefully before acting—in a way, she's becoming more like us. This was my goal all along: to shape her into our exact image.
10310225.ch: “她做什么都开始三思而行，某程度上来说，她更像我们了。我一直想把她打造得跟我们一模一样。”

10310226.en: But now... I find myself having doubts...

10310227.en: Oh! You're here, wonderful! I'm scared of running into couples meeting in the Fallen Valley and ruining their important moments. Would you accompany me through there?
10310227.ch: 咦！太好了，你来了！我很害怕在陨幽谷撞见相会的男女，坏了他们的大事，你能不能陪着我走一趟？

10310228.en: I... I'll wait for you over there, okay? You... you must come!
10310228.ch: 我……我在那边等你好吗？你……一定要来！

10310229.en: You're here! Quick, let's go inside!

10310230.en: After repairing my arms, my soul was severely damaged. That's why I must come here to find the soul fragments within.
10310230.ch: 我修复手臂后，神识受到极大损伤，因此必须来这边寻找里面的残灵。

10310231.en: Once I replenish these lost soul fragments, I'll become clearer-minded and won't make so much trouble anymore. After all, I've made quite a fool of myself lately...
10310231.ch: 只要补充散失的残灵，我就能变得聪明一些，不至于经常闯祸了。毕竟之前弄出不少笑话了……

10310232.en: Is... is that so? I've seen cultivators always meeting their loved ones in secluded places, so I thought all couples preferred it that way...
10310232.ch: 是……是吗？我看那些修士都爱和喜欢的人去没有人的地方相见，我还以为情侣间都爱这样呢……

10310233.en: Will you come inside with me? Thank you for your help! Please, if I do anything wrong, make sure to tell me!
10310233.ch: 你和我一起进去吧？麻烦你了！如果我做错什么，你请一定要告诉我！

10310234.en: After exploring the dark cave with {name|B} and collecting several wandering spirits, you prepare to leave—but {name|B} stands frozen in place. Following her gaze, you spot a human skeleton...
10310234.ch: 你与{name|B}将面前幽洞查探一遍，搜得若干残魂，正准备离开之际。{name|B}却呆呆得站着，观其所视，乃是一具已成骷髅的人体……

10310235.en: He... why is he here? He's... dead...
10310235.ch: 他……为什么会在这里？他……死了……

10310236.en: So you're saying... the Fallen Valley holds treasures that cultivators covet, and they risk everything to come here, only to perish within?
10310236.ch: 你是说……这陨幽谷中藏着不少修士喜爱的宝物，他们不惜冒险来此，终于陨身其中吗？

10310237.en: Humans... are truly greedy creatures... Once desire takes hold, they'll sacrifice everything, even their own lives...
10310237.ch: 人……真是贪心呢……有了一点欲望就在所不惜，乃至于将性命都丢了……

10310238.en: Though... who am I to judge others...
10310238.ch: 不过……我也没资格说别人……

10310239.en: I... suppose we're all the same in the end. We toil endlessly for what we desire, and once we obtain it, we only crave more. Once we've tasted pleasure, our greed knows no bounds...
10310239.ch: 其实，我感觉大家都是差不多的。营营役役，都是为了想要得到什么，可一旦得到了就想要更多，食髓知味，贪得无厌……

10310240.en: Uh... let's go... Thank you so much for accompanying me! I need to get back to building my house!
10310240.ch: 呃……我、我们走吧……很多谢你陪我呢！我还得回去建房子！

10310242.en: You mean to say... he wandered here by accident? But anyone can see how dangerous this place is. Surely no one would come here unless they sought something?
10310242.ch: 你的意思是……他不小心走到这边来了？可、可是这里面一看而知，凶险非常，若非有所求，绝不会来吧？

10310243.en: Besides, they had plenty of chances to turn back before venturing deeper... How could they be even more silly than me and accidentally stumble into such a place?
10310243.ch: 再说，深入之前，他们还有的是机会离开……他们怎么可能比我还糊涂，竟然误入此地？

10310244.en: Oh my, I've said too much! Let's go... Thank you so much for accompanying me! I need to get back to building my house!
10310244.ch: 哎呀，我说了多余的话，我、我们走吧！很多谢你陪着我呢！我还得回去建房子！

10310245.en: How strange, I'm certain this was the right way... but that couple went in that direction...
10310245.ch: 奇怪了，明明是走这边没错啊，那对男女是往那边去了呀……

10310246.en: Ah! It's you! Why are you looking at me so strangely...
10310246.ch: 啊！是你！我怎么觉得你看我的眼神怪怪的……

10310247.en: Actually... it's like this... I wanted to go to the Soul Devouring Pagoda, and there happened to be a couple heading there, so I've been following them...
10310247.ch: 其实……是这样的……我是想去噬魂塔，恰好一对男女结伴要去，所以我一直跟着他们……

10310248.en: No, no... What are you implying... Why would I be curious... They're not even lovers—wait, no, oh dear!
10310248.ch: 没有没有……你这是什么意思……我为什么要好奇……他们不是情侣，不对，哎呀！

10310249.en: I really am going to the Soul Devouring Pagoda; I'm done talking! I'm leaving!
10310249.ch: 我真的是要去噬魂塔，不跟你说了！我先走了！

10310250.en: Oh my, I must go ahead now! If I'm too slow, I won't be able to keep up with the—I mean, I must go!
10310250.ch: 哎呀，我先走一步了！要是慢了，就跟不上了！

10310251.en: Eh? You... what brings you here? I was just about to enter the Soul Devouring Pagoda!
10310251.ch: 咦？你……你怎么来了？我正要进去噬魂塔里呢！

10310252.en: I need to find some things inside... it's also for my house.
10310252.ch: 我要在里面找些东西……也是为了房子。

10310253.en: It's not enough; some things seem to be hidden... If I fix it up better, I'll be able to properly host guests when they come!
10310253.ch: 还不够，有一些东西似乎被藏……修好一点，有客人来了也好招待呀！

10310254.en: You'll come with me? That's wonderful! You know, earlier in the city I met a fellow, and he said he wanted me to be his partner! It was so frightening! What's a partner anyway? Does it mean I have to carry his luggage, supplies, and even shoes?
10310254.ch: 你愿意同我一起？太好了！你不知道，早先我在城里遇见一个家伙，说要我当他倒履，可吓人了！倒履了是什么？是让我给他提鞋吗？

10310255.en: There are always so many unexpected things happening around me, so it's really wonderful that you're willing to accompany me!
10310255.ch: 反正周围总有我意想不到的事情，你肯陪我那是最好了！

10310256.en: However, it's quite dangerous inside here. We must proceed with caution!
10310256.ch: 不过这里面，还是很凶险，我们小心应对！

10310258.en: {name|B}'s gaze fixes on something in the distance, her cheerful expression instantly freezing over. Following her line of sight, you spot a man and woman lying motionless on the ground, hands clasped together—as if in their final moments, they had desperately tried to reach each other's side.
10310258.ch: {name|B}看着远方，原本笑逐颜开的脸上瞬间凝上一层冰霜也似。你循其目光看去，只见有一对男女一动不动倒在地上，他们互相握着对方，似乎在最后一刻也拼了命要走到对方身边。

10310259.en: The couple... I saw them in the city before. The man was begging the woman to be his partner... and now they've died here. What does partner really mean...?
10310259.ch: 他们……之前我在城里看见他们，这男的求着这女的，希望她成为他的倒履……结果他们死在这边了。倒履……是什么？

10310260.en: Oh... You see, this male cultivator loved this female cultivator, and he wanted her to stay by his side, to be together... They would cultivate together, talk together, eat and sleep together. That's what being partners means—it encompasses their entire relationship...
10310260.ch: 哦……其实这个男修士喜欢这个女修士，他想要她留在身边，想要待在一起……他们修炼在一起，说话在一起，吃饭睡觉也在一起，道侣就是他们关系的总括……

10310261.en: She didn't have to die... yet she chose to follow him here anyway...
10310261.ch: 明明这个女的可以不死……却偏偏要随着他来到这边……

10310262.en: Then why are they holding each other's hands?
10310262.ch: 那他们为什么要握着对方的手？

10310263.en: Ah... I see now... but isn't that feeling rather strange?
10310263.ch: 啊……原来如此……但这种感觉好奇怪吧？

10310264.en: It makes me feel dizzy... and my heart feels strange... why would anyone like feeling this way?
10310264.ch: 有点像晕晕的……心里又有点不安……为什么会喜欢这样？

10310265.en: With a sigh, {name|B} sits down by herself, lost in thought...
10310265.ch: {name|B}一声叹息自去一边坐下发呆……

10310266.en: I'm a bit tired... I'll rest here for a moment before leaving...
10310266.ch: 我有点累，坐一会就走了……
